discounts.typicalSaving: About 10% of the room price; in German DJH hostels about EUR 3.50 per night versus the Guest Card.
discounts.howToGet: Join through the HI Norge member portal (hihostels.app) for a digital card before departure; HI requires the membership to be bought in your country of residence.
discounts.conditions: Local conditions apply: in some countries membership is compulsory, discount sizes differ, and some benefits need membership of the local association. HI Norge's discount is reported to apply when booking via hihostels.no or directly with the hostel. DJH says membership of any other national Youth Hostel Association is enough, but confirm with the hostel. Whether the discount applies to private rooms was not stated.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Yes if any nights are in HI/DJH hostel private rooms, since NOK 50 is repaid within a night or two (10% rate or avoiding German Guest Card stamps); otherwise skip.
discounts.notes: The NOK 50 price rests on two soft sources (Visit Norway listing and a search snippet of HI Norge's membership page). Interrail's pass-benefits page names Hostelworld as a partner but lists no discount. Which cities on the route have HI hostels with private rooms was not checked.

discounts.provider: a&o Hostels - student rate, ISIC and rail-pass discounts
discounts.benefit: Student offer through the free a&o Club: 20% off Fixed bookings or 10% off the Flex rate. An a&o press release (circa 2017) says ISIC holders get 10% off the daily rate at all locations plus a free soft drink. The German a&o page offers 10% off each night to holders of German, InterRail or Eurail rail passes.
discounts.typicalSaving: 10-20% of the room price.
discounts.howToGet: Register for the a&o Club, log in and book directly on aohostels.com; show ISIC at reception for the older ISIC offer.
discounts.conditions: Student page does not mention proof of student status; the rail-pass claim procedure and the locations covered were not retrieved; the ISIC press release is not dated and may be outdated.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Worth checking for hostel private rooms in a&o cities because membership is free and no ISIC is needed for the club rate, but compare the final price with apartments and Hostelworld first.
discounts.notes: a&o's rail-pass discount page did not load usable text; the 10% figure is from the German youth-hotels page.

discounts.benefit: ISIC cardholders can get a promo code for 20% off the Pay Later rate on the Generator website (listing on ISIC Portugal); other ISIC country sites show different codes.
discounts.typicalSaving: Up to 20% of the Pay Later rate.
discounts.howToGet: Request the code through the ISIC discount listing, then book on generatorhostels.com.
discounts.conditions: Bookings must be guaranteed by credit card and cannot be cancelled; an ISIC/EYCA card may be requested on arrival and the booking cancelled if not shown; the code differs by ISIC country and was not found on isic.no.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Probably not worth chasing: unverified for Norwegian ISIC holders and the rate is non-cancellable.
discounts.notes: Pages could not be opened directly; details come from search-result summaries of the ISIC Portugal and Romania listings.

discounts.provider: Airbnb, Booking.com and Hostelworld - youth/student deals
discounts.benefit: No youth or student discount found. Booking.com has no student programme (its free Genius loyalty tiers depend on stay history, 10% at entry to 20% at the top, per a third-party guide); Hostelworld has no verified student or under-26 discount; nothing was found for Airbnb.
discounts.howToGet: Not applicable.
discounts.conditions: Student Beans or UNiDAYS listings for Booking.com and Hostelworld (around 8-10%) appear on third-party pages but could not be verified.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Nothing to claim - budget at list price and use HI, a&o or Interrail partner offers where applicable.
discounts.notes: Only third-party sources were available (the fetch tool could not open these companies' own help pages in this session), so this is an absence-of-evidence finding.

discounts.ageRange: 12 and over, no upper age limit (full-time students)
discounts.cost: NOK 100 for the digital ISIC (valid 12 months, in the ISIC app); about EUR 9.3 at the project's fx rate of 10.7155 NOK/EUR. The isic.no eligibility text also mentions EUR 10.
discounts.benefit: Accepted student proof at Vy, SJ Norge (international students) and SJ Sweden; domestic Czech student fares (CD, RegioJet, FlixBus CZ); recommended for foreign students at Museo Reina Sofia; reduced student prices at Museo Thyssen and National Gallery Prague; KILROY flight offers (up to EUR 35 off); a&o and Generator hostel offers (see those entries).
discounts.howToGet: Order at isic.no ('Bestill ISIC-kortet'), document full-time student status (at least 15 hours per week for 12 weeks per year; a Norwegian university page says a student-status confirmation from Studentweb works), then activate the card in the ISIC app.
discounts.conditions: Full-time students at an approved institution; physical card option not confirmed on isic.no. Most big savings in this file (Louvre, Colosseum, Portugal, MAV, Interrail, FrecciaYOUNG, Italo Young, Avantage Jeune) are age-based and need only a passport or ID, not ISIC.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: A cheap hedge at about EUR 9 per person: it pays for itself on a single Czech domestic half-price fare, a Reina Sofia visit or a reduced Prague gallery entry, but skip it if the route avoids Czechia and Spain.
discounts.notes: Price per isic.no and a HVL (university) page. The IYTC youth card (under 30, non-students) and the EYCA European Youth Card appear on several museum pages as alternatives; their price and availability for Norwegians were not checked.

discounts.provider: France - Louvre, Musee d'Orsay and national museums (under-26 EEA free entry)
discounts.ageRange: under 26 (ministry wording 18-25; under 18 free for everyone)
discounts.benefit: Louvre: free for EEA citizens under 26 with valid photo ID, or EEA residents under 26 with photo ID plus a residence permit valid for over 90 days (the EEA list includes Norway). Ministry of Culture: permanent collections of national museums are free for 18-25-year-olds who reside regularly in an EU or EEA state. Musee d'Orsay lists under-26 EEA residents as free. Versailles: under-26 EU/EEA residents free per a third-party guide, with a free timed slot required.
discounts.typicalSaving: EUR 22 per person for the Louvre alone (standard EEA ticket; EUR 32 for non-EEA visitors).
discounts.howToGet: No card needed: carry passport or national ID; the Louvre recommends booking a free time slot online; Orsay free entry is claimed with proof at the entrance; Versailles needs a free reserved slot.
discounts.conditions: The ministry rule covers permanent collections (temporary exhibitions may be charged; not stated for under-26s); ID is checked at the entrance. The Louvre is free for everyone on the first Friday of the month after 18:00 (not July/August), which is 4 Dec 2026, just before the trip.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Yes - if Paris is a stop this is the biggest single saving (about EUR 22 per person at the Louvre alone, more with Orsay and Versailles) at no cost.
discounts.notes: Louvre and ministry pages were read directly. The Orsay billetterie page returned 403, so its rule is from a search summary; Versailles rests on a third-party guide (official site not reachable).

discounts.provider: Italy - state museums and archaeological sites (Colosseum, Herculaneum, Uffizi etc.)
discounts.ageRange: 18-25 reduced (until the day of the 25th birthday); under 18 free
discounts.benefit: EU citizens aged 18-25 pay a reduced EUR 2 ticket at the Colosseum Archaeological Park and other state sites (Herculaneum: EUR 2 reduced vs EUR 16 full). The official Colosseo page applies the free/reduced provisions of Ministerial Decree 239/2006 to citizens of Norway, Iceland, Liechtenstein and Switzerland (EEA) without stating the amount.
discounts.typicalSaving: Herculaneum EUR 14 off (EUR 16 to EUR 2); the Colosseum reduced price is EUR 2 against a full price of up to EUR 24 for the Full Experience ticket.
discounts.howToGet: Carry passport or ID; at the Colosseum Park the reduced and free tickets must be booked on ticketing.colosseo.it or bought at the ticket offices.
discounts.conditions: The CoopCulture (Herculaneum) and Colosseo pages speak of EU citizens; Norway is covered only via the Colosseo line on EEA nationals, so confirm at the ticket office. The first Sunday of each month is free for all (6 Dec 2026, the day before the trip).
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Yes if Rome, Naples/Pompeii or Florence are stops: EUR 2 entry at major state sites is a large saving for an ID check.
discounts.notes: The Colosseum Full Experience price (EUR 24) is from a search-result summary of the official site. Uffizi and other Italian state museums follow the same ministry decree but their pages were not opened.

discounts.provider: Spain - Museo Reina Sofia and Museo del Prado (students 18-25)
discounts.ageRange: students 18-25 (also under 18 free)
discounts.benefit: Museo Reina Sofia: free entry for students aged 18-25 in any degree (no nationality condition; foreign students advised to bring an ISIC), and for holders of a carne joven or equivalent. Museo del Prado: free entry for students aged 18-25 per its price page (as quoted in search results) and 50% off for EYCA/IYTC holders. Museo Thyssen: reduced (not free) price for students with a student card or ISIC, free for carne joven holders.
discounts.howToGet: Collect the free-with-accreditation ticket at the ticket office on the day, showing the accreditation document (with expiry date, Latin script or certified translation) together with passport or ID.
discounts.conditions: Free tickets with accreditation are only available at the ticket office. Reina Sofia is also free in the last two hours before closing (online reservation) and on free days (6 Dec 2026, before the trip). Prado conditions come from search snippets because the official page returned 403.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Yes if Madrid is a stop: bring a student certificate/ISIC and passport for free Reina Sofia (and likely Prado) entry.
discounts.notes: General admission prices were not retrieved, so no euro saving is stated. An announcement of a EUR 3 Alhambra price for young Europeans with the European Youth Card was seen in one snippet but is unverified.

discounts.provider: Greece - archaeological sites and museums (Acropolis etc.)
discounts.ageRange: 6-25 (EU youth up to 25 free; non-EU youth 6-25 at 50%)
discounts.benefit: EU citizens up to 25 enter free with ID card or passport; youth 6-25 from outside the EU pay 50% from 1 April to 31 October with a passport; from 1 November to 31 March every visitor gets a 50% reduced ticket, so in December the group pays half price at least.
discounts.typicalSaving: 50% in December (all visitors); free entry only if Greece treats Norwegians as EU youth, which is unconfirmed.
discounts.howToGet: Show passport or ID at the ticket desk; timed-entry slots apply at major Athens sites per third-party guides.
discounts.conditions: The rule text names 'member states of the European Union' for free entry and 'countries outside the European Union' for the 50% rate; Norway is EEA but not EU and is not mentioned. Free days: first Sunday of each month from 1 Nov to 31 Mar (6 Dec 2026, before the trip), 28 Oct, 18 Apr, 18 May, 6 Mar and the last weekend of September.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Only if Athens is a stop: expect the winter 50% rate rather than free entry unless the ticket office accepts EEA youth as EU youth.
discounts.notes: Rules read from the EU Eurydice page quoting the Greek ministry (updated March 2026); the ministry page itself returned 403. Actual ticket prices were not retrieved.

discounts.provider: Portugal - Museus e Monumentos de Portugal (Jeronimos, Belem Tower etc.)
discounts.ageRange: 13-24 inclusive
discounts.benefit: 50% off the regular ticket for visitors aged 13 to 24 inclusive; no nationality or residency condition is stated. Children up to 12 are free; residents of Portugal get 52 free days per year with the citizen card.
discounts.typicalSaving: Jeronimos Monastery EUR 18 to EUR 9; Belem Tower EUR 15 to EUR 7.50 (50% of the listed prices).
discounts.howToGet: Show passport or ID at the ticket office or validation point; free tickets and discounts require a valid official document.
discounts.conditions: The page does not list which documents prove age; 'unemployed visitors residing in the EU' and teachers/students on study visits have separate free categories.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Yes if Lisbon is a stop: about EUR 16.50 saved for Jeronimos plus Belem Tower, at no cost.
discounts.notes: Prices shown on the official tickets page on the date of checking.

discounts.provider: Germany - Staatliche Museen zu Berlin (Museum Island etc.)
discounts.ageRange: under 18 free; students any age at 50%
discounts.benefit: 50% reduced admission for pupils, trainees and students (with a certificate); free admission up to the 18th birthday. The page has no rule for visitors under 26 or for EU/EEA residents and does not mention ISIC or foreign student IDs.
discounts.typicalSaving: 50% of the full ticket price (prices not retrieved).
discounts.howToGet: Show a student certificate at the entrance without being asked.
discounts.conditions: University students are free only in registered groups attending courses. No German-wide EU under-26 scheme was found; other Berlin and Dresden museums set their own rules.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Modest: only a 50% student reduction (bring a student certificate), no free entry for 23-year-olds.
discounts.notes: Germany has no equivalent of the French/Spanish under-26 freebies in sources found; the first-Sunday 'Museumssonntag' (6 Dec 2026) is before the trip.

discounts.provider: Czechia - National Gallery Prague (and Prague Castle)
discounts.ageRange: 16-26 (reduced); under 15 free
discounts.benefit: National Gallery Prague long-term collections: reduced admission for young people aged 16 to 26 and for students with a valid ISIC; free for children under 15. Prague Castle Main Circuit: reduced CZK 300 against a basic CZK 450 for students up to 26 with ID, per third-party guides.
discounts.typicalSaving: Prague Castle about CZK 150 per person (third-party figures); the Gallery's reduced percentage was not stated.
discounts.howToGet: Show passport or student ID/ISIC at the ticket desk.
discounts.conditions: The gallery page mentions no nationality or residency requirement; the two reduced categories appear with typos on the page. Prague Castle student rules were not confirmed on hrad.cz.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Modest: reduced prices of roughly one third off at Prague Castle if Prague is a stop; carry ISIC to be safe.
discounts.notes: Prague Castle's own site returned 403; figures are from third-party guides. Older sources said the Gallery's permanent collection is free for everyone under 26 (Komerční banka sponsorship from 2015); the current page lists reduced admission instead.

discounts.provider: Poland - National Museum in Warsaw (and Wawel Royal Castle)
discounts.ageRange: students under 26
discounts.benefit: National Museum in Warsaw: 1 PLN ticket for children, teenagers and students under 26 (ticket office only); permanent galleries free on Tuesdays; regular ticket 30 PLN, reduced 15 PLN; 50% off all tickets on Fridays 17:00-20:00 (not on 1 PLN tickets). Wawel Royal Castle: reduced tickets for young people up to 26 with a valid student ID (third-party, EYCA also listed).
discounts.typicalSaving: 29 PLN per person against the regular permanent-gallery ticket (30 PLN), or free on a Tuesday.
discounts.howToGet: Buy the 1 PLN ticket at the museum ticket office showing student ID or ISIC; Tuesdays need no ticket for the permanent exhibition.
discounts.conditions: The page does not say whether proof is required or whether foreign students qualify, and does not mention ISIC; the Tuesday free admission excludes temporary exhibitions. Tuesdays inside the trip window: 8 Dec and 15 Dec 2026.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Yes if Warsaw is a stop: free permanent galleries on Tuesday 8 or 15 Dec, or 1 PLN with a student card on other days.
discounts.notes: National Museum figures come from the official page; Wawel's own page returned 404, so its youth rule is third-party and unverified.

discounts.ageRange: students under 26; children and youth under 19 free
discounts.benefit: Belvedere: students under 26 pay EUR 19 for the Upper Belvedere (standard EUR 23), EUR 16 for the Lower Belvedere (EUR 20) and EUR 8 for Belvedere 21 (EUR 12); under-19s free. Albertina and Kunsthistorisches Museum are also free for under-19s (third-party sources).
discounts.typicalSaving: EUR 4 per person per Belvedere site.
discounts.howToGet: Choose the student price at the ticket desk or online and show a student ID.
discounts.conditions: The page does not state which proof is required. At 23 the group gets only student prices, not free entry; no student rate for the KHM or Albertina was confirmed.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Small: about EUR 4 off per Belvedere ticket with a student ID.
discounts.notes: Search for KHM and Albertina student rates was not possible after the web-search budget ran out; check khm.at and albertina.at.

discounts.provider: Hungary - Hungarian National Museum and National Gallery (Budapest)
discounts.ageRange: 6-26 for the youth ticket; EEA citizens under 26 for the free day
discounts.benefit: Hungarian National Museum: youth ticket 1,750 HUF for Hungarian and EEA citizens aged 6-26 (adult 3,500 HUF); permanent exhibitions free on the third Saturday of each month for EEA citizens under 26; free for everyone on 15 March, 20 August and 23 October. Hungarian National Gallery: 50% discount for EEA citizens aged 6-26 (search summary of the official site).
discounts.typicalSaving: 1,750 HUF per person (50% of the adult ticket).
discounts.howToGet: Show passport or ID with photo plus proof of eligibility at the ticket desk.
discounts.conditions: The free third-Saturday in December 2026 is 19 Dec, after the trip window (Saturday 12 Dec is the second Saturday); the discount requires a photo ID or passport.
discounts.worthItForThisTrip: Modest: half-price tickets (1,750 HUF) at the National Museum if Budapest is a stop; the free day falls outside 7-15 Dec.
discounts.notes: National Museum prices and rules read from the official page; the National Gallery page returned a server error, so its 50% figure comes from a search summary.

activities.name: Mo Rocks Weekender 2026 (party weekend)
activities.blurb: Four-night party weekend with pool and beach parties by day and club nights in Agadir; ages 21+, accommodation not included.
activities.priceText: Early-bird entertainment pass from GBP 120 (GBP 50 deposit to secure); other ticket tiers not shown
activities.when: Thu 3 Dec (22:00) to Mon 7 Dec 2026, Agadir clubs and venues; no refunds

activities.name: Souk El Had
activities.blurb: Huge market with 3,000+ stalls for fruit, spices, leather and souvenirs; touts approach tourists at the main gates.

activities.name: Agadir Kasbah (Fortress)
activities.blurb: Surviving part of the old fortress on the hill beside town; walk up or take a taxi (30–50 dirham).

activities.name: Memory of Agadir Museum
activities.blurb: Small photo museum on the 29 February 1960 earthquake; the sign is missing, so look for the iron gates.

activities.name: Museum Municipal du Patrimoine Amazigh
activities.blurb: Small municipal museum of Berber objects: old instruments, jewellery, traditional clothing and manuscripts.

activities.name: K-moon
activities.blurb: Small restaurant serving excellent wood-fire grilled meat with many small side bowls; quick, efficient service.

activities.name: Herguita
activities.blurb: Restaurant with an ocean view and typical local food; the brochettes (skewers) are the ones to order.

activities.name: Rotisserie Al Marché
activities.blurb: Authentic Moroccan street-food counter known for its sandwiches; a cheap, quick bite.

activities.name: Agadir beach
activities.blurb: Large town beach that is usually not crowded; it can be very windy, as in February, so bring a layer.

activities.name: Surfing around Agadir
activities.blurb: Surf breaks such as Imsouane, Devil's Rock and Anchor Point, with many surf schools and camps nearby.

activities.name: Calle Larios Christmas light-and-sound show
activities.blurb: Calle Larios becomes a synchronised light-and-music show, with a video-mapping on the cathedral tower nearby.
activities.when: Passes 18:30/20:30/22:00, last Friday of Nov to 5 Jan (2025 pattern); 2026 dates TBA

activities.name: Paseo del Parque Christmas market
activities.blurb: Seasonal market stalls along Málaga's palm-lined Paseo del Parque, a short walk from the Calle Larios lights.
activities.priceText: Free entry; pay only for purchases
activities.when: Daily ~11:00-22:00, listed 27 Nov-7 Jan; council programme not yet out

activities.name: Málaga CF v FC Barcelona (LaLiga)
activities.blurb: Málaga CF welcome FC Barcelona to La Rosaleda on LaLiga matchday 16; day and kick-off still to be set.
activities.when: LaLiga matchday 16, listed Sun 13 Dec 2026; day/kick-off TBA

activities.name: Alcazaba
activities.blurb: Best-preserved Moorish castle in Spain, built in the 11th century on a hill; the ramparts give views over the city.
activities.priceText: General €7; reduced €3 (European Youth Card holders, EU citizens with student proof, 65+); free Sundays from 14:00 (official price list)

activities.name: Málaga Cathedral
activities.blurb: Cathedral in the city centre; open every day, but on Sundays only from 14:00.

activities.name: Malaga Aviation Museum
activities.blurb: Free museum in a 1940s airport terminal, with old aircraft, uniforms and airport models; fun for kids too.

activities.name: Picasso Museum
activities.blurb: Paintings and artworks by the Málaga-born artist; your ticket also covers rotating exhibitions by other artists.

activities.name: Restaurante Gallego Candamil
activities.blurb: Galician restaurant popular with locals; cheap tapas such as empanada, with a glass of cider for little.
activities.priceText: Tapa of empanada €1.25, glass of cider €1.15 (Wikivoyage)

activities.name: Central Market (Mercado Central de Atarazanas)
activities.blurb: Lively 19th-century wrought-iron market with regional produce, olive oil, fish, meat and cheese.

activities.name: Central Beers
activities.blurb: Belgian beer bar with a good range of Belgian brews; busy at weekends.

activities.name: Birras Deluxe
activities.blurb: Belgian and American-style beers on tap, friendly staff, and food available.

activities.name: Escapada Cycling
activities.blurb: Gravel, e-bike, trekking and mountain bike rental, plus guided cycling experiences.

activities.name: Sightseeing Treasure Hunt Málaga
activities.blurb: Sightseeing treasure hunt with a bag of clues and a treasure book; by appointment, tours last at least 2.5 hours.
activities.when: By appointment; tours at least 2.5 hours

activities.name: Alicante Christmas lights and Mercado de Navidad
activities.blurb: Christmas lights across the centre and a market of stalls along Paseo de Federico Soto, running into early January.
activities.priceText: Free to walk around; purchases extra
activities.when: 2025-26 pattern: programme 5 Dec-5 Jan, market to 6 Jan; 2026 dates TBA

activities.name: Elche CF v Sevilla FC (LaLiga, in nearby Elche)
activities.blurb: Alicante has no top-flight club; Elche, next door, host Sevilla on LaLiga matchday 16. Day and kick-off still to be set.
activities.when: LaLiga matchday 16, listed Sun 13 Dec 2026; day/kick-off TBA

activities.name: Castell de la Santa Bàrbara
activities.blurb: Muslim-built fortress on Mount Benacantil, 166 m up, with huge views over the town and harbour. Free.

activities.name: Museu de Belles Arts Gravina (MUBAG)
activities.blurb: Free fine-arts museum in an 18th-century palace, with Spanish artworks displayed over three floors.
activities.when: 1 Sep–30 Jun Tue–Sat 10:00–20:00; Sun and holidays 10:00–14:00

activities.name: Museu d'Art Contemporani d'Alacant (MACA)
activities.blurb: Free modern-art museum with works by Picasso, Braque, Miró and Juan Gris, plus two local artists.

activities.name: Museu Arqueològic Provincial d'Alacant (MARQ)
activities.blurb: Provincial archaeology museum in a converted hospital, with an avant-garde design and strong regional finds.
activities.priceText: €6 weekdays, €3 Sundays and holidays; reduced €3 for students, Carnet Jove holders and over-65s (official tariffs; proof required)

activities.name: El Nou Cisne
activities.blurb: Simple tapas and raciones bar with a set menu; the €11.90 price dates from 2016, so check it on arrival.

activities.name: Mercat Central (Alicante)
activities.blurb: Two levels of meat, seafood, cheese, fruit and vegetables, with flower sellers in a small square at the back.

activities.name: Sala Stereo
activities.blurb: Concert venue for about 280 people with indie, rock and electronic music; Friday and Saturday DJ sessions.
activities.when: DJ sessions Fri and Sat from 03:30

activities.name: Sala The One
activities.blurb: Large venue for around 1,000 with rock, punk and post-punk concerts and club nights; popular with students.

activities.name: Coves del Canelobre
activities.blurb: Large cave network with stalactites and one of Spain's highest vaults, a day trip inland from Alicante.
activities.when: 1 Sep–30 Jun Tue–Fri 10:30–16:50; Sat, Sun, holidays 10:30–17:50; closed 25 Dec and 1 Jan

activities.name: Amsterdam Light Festival 2026-27
activities.blurb: Light artworks along the canals, seen free on foot or from a canal cruise; lit every evening from late November.
activities.priceText: Free to see from the street; Light Walk app EUR 6.99; canal cruises from EUR 29.75 (children 4-12 half price)
activities.when: 26 Nov 2026-17 Jan 2027, lights on daily 16:30-23:00 (31 Dec until 21:00)

activities.name: Ajax v SC Cambuur (Eredivisie)
activities.blurb: Sunday-night league game at the Johan Cruijff ArenA; the club's page showed only last tickets in October.

activities.name: Ajax v Getafe (UEFA Conference League)
activities.blurb: European night at the Johan Cruijff ArenA; single tickets showed sold out on Ajax's site, with official resale open.

activities.name: Museum Willet-Holthuysen
activities.blurb: Fully furnished 17th-century canal house with silverware, porcelain and books; a quiet, cheap alternative to the big museums.

activities.name: Anne Frank House
activities.blurb: Secret annex where Anne Frank hid from the Nazis and wrote her diary; book online well ahead, as same-day slots are few.

activities.name: Rijksmuseum
activities.blurb: Dutch Golden Age masterpieces, including Rembrandt's Night Watch and Vermeer's Milkmaid; there is no student discount.

activities.name: Van Gogh Museum
activities.blurb: Largest collection of Van Gogh's paintings and drawings; tickets are online only and can sell out weeks ahead.

activities.name: Albina
activities.blurb: Cheap, very good food in Zuid with plain surroundings; arrive before dinnertime or expect to wait for a table.

activities.name: Van der Linde
activities.blurb: Bakery famous for Amsterdam's whipped ice cream, a creamy, melt-in-the-mouth treat; the almond cookies are good too.

activities.name: Sugar Factory
activities.blurb: Art, music and theatre under one roof, with a nightclub at its heart; relaxed, eccentric and a bit different.

activities.name: Hannekes Boom
activities.blurb: Snug, unpolished bar on the IJ waterfront, good for a beer and a chat rather than a clubbing night.

activities.name: Brouwerij de Prael
activities.blurb: Brewery, tasting room and beer shop in one, in the city centre; four beers for €10 is an easy way to sample local brews.
activities.priceText: Brewery tour or beer tasting with four beers €10
activities.when: Tasting room Tue–Sat 12:00–24:00, Sun 12:00–23:00; beer shop 12:00–19:00

activities.name: ICE* Amsterdam
activities.blurb: Open-air ice rink of about 1,400 m² on the Museumplein, open daily in winter; a fun skate beside the museums.

activities.name: Christmas Village at Pedion tou Areos (ice rink and shows)
activities.blurb: Usually a free seasonal village in Areos Park with an ice rink, pop-up shops and music and theatre shows.
activities.priceText: Free entry to all activities (2025 listing)
activities.when: Usually runs through December to early January; 2026 dates not yet announced

activities.name: DEI Christmas Factory at Technopolis (Gazi)
activities.blurb: Big festive park in the old gasworks: ice rink, fun-fair rides, Christmas market and a stage show, near Kerameikos metro.
activities.priceText: General admission from EUR 5; entry with ice rink EUR 17 (weekends until 22 Dec, daily from 23 Dec); theatre show from EUR 15 incl. entry

activities.name: AEK Athens v Galatasaray (UEFA Champions League)
activities.blurb: Champions League league-phase match at AEK's OPAP Arena against Istanbul giants Galatasaray; matchday 6.
activities.when: Tue 8 Dec 2026 (matchday 6); evening kick-off time set by UEFA; OPAP Arena (Agia Sophia), Nea Filadelfeia

activities.name: Panathinaikos v Brighton (UEFA Conference League)
activities.blurb: Last Conference League league-phase night for Panathinaikos at home, against Premier League side Brighton.

activities.name: Parthenon
activities.blurb: Fifth-century BC temple on the Acropolis, built in thanks for the victory over the Persians; later a church, then a mosque.

activities.name: Museum of Greek Folk Art
activities.blurb: Overlooked folk-art museum in Plaka: tools, folk pottery, primitive painting and furnished interiors; very cheap.
activities.priceText: €2; students from non-EU countries €1; under-19s and EU students with ID free

activities.name: Acropolis Museum
activities.blurb: Modern museum at the foot of the Acropolis; timed-entry tickets are required, so buy online in advance.

activities.name: National Archaeological Museum

activities.name: To Kioupi (basement taverna)

activities.name: Laiki (People's market)

activities.name: Taf (The Art Foundation)

activities.name: Pame Psirri

activities.name: Stavros Niarchos Cultural Centre
activities.blurb: Free cultural complex in Kallithea with a terrace view of the Acropolis and the coast; good for a relaxed afternoon.

activities.when: Sun 13 Dec 2026 per the TFF fixture list; kick-off time not yet set; Antalya Stadium (ADO Antalya Stadyumu)

activities.name: St Nicholas Day service at Demre (Myra), the real Santa Claus's church

activities.name: Hıdırlık Tower

activities.name: Perge

activities.name: Aspendos

activities.name: Ethnographic Museum
activities.blurb: Museum of traditional arts and crafts in Antalya. Free entry, open every day.

activities.name: Atatürk House Museum
activities.blurb: Rebuilt mansion with memorabilia from Atatürk's stays in Antalya in 1930, 1931 and 1935. Free entry.

activities.name: Piyazcı Sami
activities.blurb: Budget spot for Antalya-style piyaz (bean salad), köfte and other local dishes.

activities.name: Paradise Restaurant
activities.blurb: Sports bar serving decent food, open until 02:00 every day.

activities.name: King's Pool (Kral Havuzu)

activities.name: Sandland Sand Sculpture Park

activities.name: Kurşunlu Waterfall

activities.name: Riddle Bar
activities.blurb: Speakeasy-style cocktail bar with no fixed menu; the bartenders suggest drinks based on what you like.

activities.name: Dogma Brewery Central
activities.blurb: Brewery taproom with eight rotating taps, canned releases, bar food and a small courtyard.

activities.name: Public Observatory
activities.blurb: Four small telescopes for daytime city views; on Friday and Saturday evenings you can watch the sky with staff, if it is clear.
activities.when: Fri and Sat night viewing from 20:30, if clear

activities.name: Winter City Ada ice rink
activities.blurb: Winter ice skating at Winter City Ada; other winter rinks are at Pionir Ice Hall and the Olimp sports centre.

activities.name: Lucia Christmas Market (Kulturbrauerei)
activities.blurb: Scandinavian-style Christmas market in Prenzlauer Berg's old brewery, with open fires, a yurt and Nordic treats.
activities.priceText: Free admission (Berlin city listing of free-entry markets)

activities.name: WeihnachtsZauber Gendarmenmarkt
activities.blurb: Upmarket Christmas market framed by the French and German cathedrals and the Konzerthaus on Gendarmenmarkt square.
activities.priceText: EUR 2 entry; free Mon–Fri 12:00–14:00 (not 24–26 and 31 Dec); under 12s free

activities.name: Christmas Garden Berlin (Botanical Garden light trail)
activities.blurb: Illuminated walking trail through Berlin's Botanical Garden with light installations; open-air, timed-slot tickets.
activities.priceText: Adult from EUR 16.90 online (up to 27.90; box office 29.90); students from 12.90 Mon–Thu only (not 18 Dec–2 Jan), ID required
activities.when: 18 Nov 2026–10 Jan 2027; tickets are for a booked day and time slot

activities.name: Hertha BSC vs Darmstadt 98 (2. Bundesliga)
activities.blurb: Second-division home game for Hertha at the Olympiastadion; the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
activities.priceText: EUR 25–65 for the Fürth home game, EUR 30–75 for Bielefeld (club ticket news, 2026/27); Darmstadt prices not yet published
activities.when: Sun 13 Dec 2026 (matchday 15; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 11–13 Dec)

activities.name: East Side Gallery
activities.blurb: The longest surviving stretch of the Berlin Wall, covered in murals painted in 1991 and restored after years of decay. Free.

activities.name: Topography of Terror
activities.blurb: Free outdoor and indoor history museum on the former Gestapo and SS headquarters site, documenting Nazi terror.

activities.name: DDR Museum
activities.blurb: Hands-on look at everyday life in East Germany; you can touch and examine almost every exhibit.

activities.name: Pergamon Museum
activities.blurb: Classical antiquity and Islamic art in a grand building, but a major refurbishment is under way, so check which halls are open.

activities.name: Mustafas Gemüse Kebap
activities.blurb: Locally famous döner stand that draws tourists and Berliners at all hours; expect a 20–40 minute wait for your kebab.
activities.priceText: Chicken döner with vegetable €2.90; vegetable kebap €3.50

activities.name: Markthalle Neun
activities.blurb: Market hall for food and produce, a practical place to pick up lunch or a picnic. Closed Sundays.

activities.name: Clärchens Ballhaus
activities.blurb: Ballroom from 1913 with a hall of mirrors, known for swing, salsa, tango and disco nights; dancing starts at 21:00.
activities.priceText: €5 on weekends; usually free on weeknights
activities.when: Daily from 11:00; dance from 21:00; to about 00:00 weeknights, 04:00 weekends

activities.name: Berghain / Panorama Bar
activities.blurb: Legendary techno club in an old cogeneration plant near Ostbahnhof; the Panorama Bar upstairs runs late until Sunday afternoon.
activities.when: Panorama Bar open late, until Sunday afternoon (per source)

activities.name: Bus 100 and 200 city tour
activities.blurb: Ordinary city buses that pass many landmarks between Zoologischer Garten and Alexanderplatz; a cheap sightseeing ride.
activities.when: Every 5–10 minutes, Zoologischer Garten to Alexanderplatz

activities.name: Rübezahl ice rink (Müggelsee)
activities.blurb: Waterside restaurant and beer garden at Müggelsee with an ice-skating rink in winter; the food is good but on the pricey side.
activities.when: Ice rink in winter; dates not listed

activities.name: BilbaoGabonak Christmas market (Parque de Doña Casilda)
activities.blurb: Wooden-hut Christmas market around a light-and-sound tunnel by the Guggenheim, with live music, street theatre and kids' workshops.
activities.priceText: Free entry (2025-26 edition); purchases and drinks are priced per hut
activities.when: Usual pattern: about 5 Dec-5 Jan (2025-26 edition ran 5 Dec 2025-5 Jan 2026, 35 huts); 2026-27 dates not yet announced

activities.name: Athletic Club v Real Madrid (La Liga)
activities.blurb: Matchday 15 at San Mamés with Real Madrid visiting, the big fixture of Athletic's December home games.
activities.when: Sun 6 Dec 2026 per the club site, which still says 'date and time to be confirmed' (LaLiga sets the final slot); San Mamés

activities.name: Surne Bilbao Basket v Casademont Zaragoza (Liga Endesa)
activities.blurb: Spanish top-flight basketball at Bilbao Arena in Miribilla, a Sunday-lunchtime home game against Casademont Zaragoza.

activities.name: La Oreja de Van Gogh at Bizkaia Arena BEC
activities.blurb: Spanish pop band La Oreja de Van Gogh play a third date at Bizkaia Arena BEC in Barakaldo, next to Bilbao.
activities.when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 21:00 (third date; from a concert-listing site, not yet checked with the promoter)

activities.name: Puppy (Jeff Koons)
activities.blurb: Jeff Koons' flower-covered West Highland terrier, 12 m tall, outside the Guggenheim. A city symbol, free to see.

activities.name: Museo Diocesano de Arte Sacro
activities.blurb: Sacred art in a former Dominican convent founded in 1515. Cheap, closed Mondays, and free on Tuesdays.
activities.priceText: General €3; student, senior and under-18 €1.50; free on Tuesdays

activities.name: Euskal Museoa (Basque Museum)
activities.blurb: Basque prehistory, archaeology, folk life and history. The layout is modest, but it is cheap and free on Thursdays.
activities.priceText: Adults €3.50; 65+, ages 12-26 and groups €2; children under 12 and everyone on Thursdays free
activities.when: Mon, Wed-Fri 10:00-19:00; Sat 10:00-13:30 and 16:00-19:00; Sun 11:00-14:00; closed Tue and holidays

activities.name: Itsasmuseum
activities.blurb: Maritime museum in the former Euskalduna shipyard, with indoor galleries and a big outdoor exhibition area.

activities.name: Guggenheim Museum Bilbao
activities.blurb: Gehry's titanium-clad modern art museum on the Nervión, a landmark of 1990s urban renewal.
activities.priceText: Adult €18; ages 18-26 €9 (show ID at the desk); under 18 free
activities.when: Tue-Sun 10:00-19:00; also open Mon 7 and 28 Dec; closed 25 Dec

activities.name: Mercado de la Ribera
activities.blurb: Huge covered food market from 1929 beside San Antón church, selling fish, meat and produce.

activities.name: Malatesta
activities.blurb: Pintxos bar and cultural space in the Siete Calles, with vegetarian options and regular exhibitions.

activities.name: Kafe Antzokia
activities.blurb: Former theatre turned concert venue that promotes Basque culture, with a varied programme of local and international acts.

activities.name: Singular
activities.blurb: Beer bar with a good choice on draught, at least one local beer on tap, cans too, and raciones for a snack.

activities.name: Vizcaya Bridge (Puente Colgante)
activities.blurb: Hanging transporter bridge over the Nervión and a UNESCO industrial site. A Barik card works for the crossing.

activities.name: National Day and Father's Day (5 December)
activities.blurb: Public holiday honouring the late King Bhumibol, with yellow decorations and candlelit ceremonies around the city.
activities.when: Sat 5 Dec 2026 (annual public holiday; Constitution Day follows on Thu 10 Dec)

activities.name: Tomorrowland Thailand (Pattaya)
activities.blurb: Three-day edition of the Belgian dance festival at Wisdom Valley near Pattaya, a couple of hours from Bangkok; reported sold out.
activities.priceText: THB 5,100 for a 1-day pass, THB 12,500 for 3 days (listing); 2026 edition reported sold out, waitlist only
activities.when: Fri 11 to Sun 13 Dec 2026, Wisdom Valley, Pattaya (Chonburi)

activities.name: BTS World Tour 'ARIRANG' in Bangkok
activities.blurb: Three BTS stadium nights at Rajamangala; all sold out, so expect packed hotels and high resale prices around 3-6 Dec.
activities.when: Thu 3, Sat 5 and Sun 6 Dec 2026, Rajamangala National Stadium; all three shows sold out

activities.name: Vijit Chao Phraya Light Festival
activities.blurb: Annual light festival that transforms Bangkok's Chao Phraya riverside with illuminated displays and colour after dark.
activities.when: 9 Nov to 23 Dec 2026 per a December-events guide; organiser dates, hours and entry price not checked

activities.name: Wonderfruit 2026 (Chonburi)
activities.blurb: Five-day music, art and food festival at Siam Country Club near Pattaya, a couple of hours from Bangkok; tickets on a waitlist.
activities.when: Thu 3 to Mon 7 Dec 2026, The Fields at Siam Country Club, Chonburi; waitlist open, ticket prices not shown

activities.name: Wat Rakhang (Temple of the Bells)
activities.blurb: Thonburi temple named the Temple of the Bells after a huge bell found there; the visit is free.

activities.name: Grand Palace and Wat Phra Kaeo
activities.blurb: Royal palace complex that holds Wat Phra Kaeo and the Emerald Buddha; the must-see sight in central Bangkok.
activities.priceText: 500 baht for foreigners, incl. Wat Phra Kaeo and Queen Sirikit Museum of Textile; Thai citizens free with ID card
activities.when: Daily 08:30–15:30 (tickets sold until 15:30; site footer says 16:30)

activities.name: Bangkok Art and Culture Centre (BACC)
activities.blurb: Free art centre in Siam Square with interactive exhibits and temporary shows across performance, music, painting and film.

activities.name: National Museum Bangkok
activities.blurb: Bangkok's national museum in the old Front Palace grounds; attractive in parts but sprawling, so pick what you want to see.
activities.priceText: 200 baht for foreigners; 30 baht for Thais

activities.name: Roti-Mataba
activities.blurb: Popular Thai-Muslim eatery near Khao San with roti, mataba stuffed pancakes and massaman curry; sit downstairs for the local feel.

activities.name: Krua Apsorn
activities.blurb: Unpretentious Dusit restaurant with authentic traditional Thai cooking; it won a Bangkok Post best-restaurant contest in 2006.

activities.name: Overtone Music Cave
activities.blurb: Live-music bar on Royal City Avenue where every seat faces the stage; jazz, rock and blues, with the focus on listening.

activities.name: Brick Bar
activities.blurb: Underground ska and reggae bar on Khao San with live bands and an old-style Western interior; packed at weekends, and IDs are checked.

activities.name: Shewa Spa
activities.blurb: A bit pricier than the nearby parlours but cleaner and more professional, with well-trained staff for Thai, oil and herbal massage.

activities.name: Follow Me Bicycle Tours
activities.blurb: Half-day bike ride through Bangkok's residential streets; a fish spa and a barbecue meal come with the price.

activities.name: Antica Fiera di Santa Lucia (Christmas fair)
activities.blurb: Bologna's long-running Christmas fair, held under the porticoes of Strada Maggiore by the Servi church.
activities.priceText: Free to walk around; purchases extra

activities.name: French Christmas Village (Piazza Minghetti)
activities.blurb: French-themed Christmas village in Piazza Minghetti, open only over the Immaculate Conception long weekend.
activities.priceText: Free to walk around; purchases extra

activities.name: Virtus Bologna v Maccabi Tel Aviv (EuroLeague basketball)
activities.blurb: Virtus Bologna host Maccabi Tel Aviv at the Unipol Arena in EuroLeague round 16, a Friday 20:30 tip-off.
activities.when: Fri 11 Dec 2026, 20:30 (EuroLeague round 16); also v ASVEL Tue 15 Dec

activities.name: Bologna v Roma (Serie A)
activities.blurb: Bologna FC host Roma at the Dall'Ara on Serie A matchday 14, a Friday-night 20:45 kick-off.

activities.name: Basilica di San Petronio
activities.blurb: Gothic basilica on Piazza Maggiore, planned as the world's largest church; only the long arm was finished, leaving the facade unfinished.

activities.name: Museo Davia Bargellini
activities.blurb: Quirky 17th-century palazzo museum with a marionette theatre, an 18th-century gilded carriage and antique keys; free.
activities.when: Tue–Fri 09:00–13:00; Sat, Sun & holidays 10:00–18:30; closed Mon

activities.name: Palazzo dell'Archiginnasio (Teatro Anatomico)
activities.blurb: Former university palace whose wooden anatomy theatre is the highlight; cheap, but the theatre needs an online booking.

activities.name: Pinacoteca Nazionale di Bologna
activities.blurb: Bologna's main painting gallery: 13th–18th-century Emilian and Venetian art, with must-see works by Giotto, Raphael and Parmigianino.

activities.name: Mercato di Mezzo
activities.blurb: Covered food hall in the centre with a range of local stalls and tables; good value for lunch or dinner and busy all day.

activities.name: Trattoria Da Vito
activities.blurb: Down-to-earth trattoria with genuine Bolognese dishes from antipasto to dessert; popular with locals, service can be brusque.

activities.name: Covo Club
activities.blurb: Storied indie-rock and punk club since 1980, with concerts and DJ sets on Friday and Saturday nights.

activities.name: The Link
activities.blurb: Two-floor club for avant-garde electronic, techno and hip-hop gigs and DJ sets, with a small alternative bookshop inside.

activities.name: San Luca portico walk
activities.blurb: Climb the 600-plus arches of the portico from Porta Saragozza to the San Luca sanctuary for city views; the bus is the easy option.

activities.name: Bordeaux Christmas Market (Place des Quinconces)
activities.blurb: Over a hundred wooden chalets of crafts and regional food, a lit carousel by the Grand Théâtre and street performers.
activities.priceText: No entry fee listed; food, drinks and rides cost extra
activities.when: 27 Nov-27 Dec 2026, daily 11:00-21:30; Place des Quinconces and Allées de Tourny

activities.name: Swan Lake, Opéra National de Bordeaux ballet
activities.blurb: New staging of Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake by Rachel Beaujean and Colin Richmond, with Odette choosing her own fate.
activities.priceText: Opera 2026/27 grid runs from EUR 10 (reduced-view 4th-category seats) to EUR 115; show category not stated. Under-28s: 50% off, or EUR 10 seats via the youth su
activities.when: 9 Dec 2026-3 Jan 2027, Grand Théâtre; evenings 20:00 and Sunday matinees 15:00 (in the window: 9-11, 13-18 Dec)

activities.name: Lang Lang piano recital (Grand Théâtre de Bordeaux)
activities.blurb: Lang Lang plays Mozart, Beethoven's Pathétique and Op. 110, Albéniz, Granados and Liszt at the Opéra National de Bordeaux.
activities.when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 20:00-22:00, Grand Théâtre (Opéra National de Bordeaux)

activities.name: Radio Classique Christmas Concert (Bordeaux Aquitaine National Orchestra)
activities.blurb: Audience-voted Christmas programme from the Bordeaux Aquitaine National Orchestra and Opera Chorus, conducted by Joseph Swensen.
activities.when: Thu 17 and Fri 18 Dec 2026 at 20:00; also Sun 20 Dec at 15:00 and 20:00; Opéra National de Bordeaux

activities.name: Jardin Botanique (Jardin Public)
activities.blurb: Public botanical garden with roots in a 1629 herb garden. The grounds are free; exhibitions cost extra.

activities.name: Cathédrale Saint-André
activities.blurb: Gothic cathedral begun in 1170 and restored after the Revolution. Climb the detached Pey-Berland bell tower for views.

activities.name: Musée National des Douanes
activities.blurb: Surprisingly good history of border control and smuggling. Signs are French-only, so take the audioguide.

activities.name: Musée des Beaux-Arts de Bordeaux
activities.blurb: Western painting and sculpture from the Renaissance to the early 20th century, spread over two wings.
activities.priceText: Full €8 when the Galerie des Beaux-Arts is open, €6 when it is closed; reduced €4.50; students under 26 €2; under 18 free
activities.when: Wed-Mon 11:00-18:00; closed Tue and public holidays

activities.name: Musée d'Aquitaine
activities.blurb: Regional history from the Stone Age through Roman times to the early modern era; temporary shows are included.
activities.when: Tue-Sun 11:00-18:00; closed Mon and public holidays

activities.name: Musée du Vin et du Négoce
activities.blurb: Wine-trade museum covering two thousand years of regional winemaking; the ticket includes two wine tastings.

activities.name: L'Entrecôte
activities.blurb: Bordeaux institution with one set menu: walnut salad, sirloin, matchstick fries and the house sauce. No reservations, so expect a queue.

activities.name: El Chuchumbe
activities.blurb: Latin bar with cheap mojitos that turns into a salsa dance floor towards midnight.

activities.name: Jeux Barjo
activities.blurb: Board-game bar with ancient and modern games. You pay per game, staff will teach you one, and tournaments run here.

activities.name: The Frog and Rosbif
activities.blurb: English pub with its own micro-brewery in a 16th-century former women's prison, popular for live sport on TV.

activities.name: Festa di San Nicola (St Nicholas Day, 6 Dec)
activities.blurb: Bari honours its patron saint on 6 Dec: very early masses, big crowds and street-food stalls fill the old town through the night.
activities.when: Night of 5-6 Dec every year; masses from about 04:00 at the Basilica; 2026 programme not yet published

activities.name: Natale a Bari: Christmas village, tree lights and old-town markets
activities.blurb: Bari's Christmas programme usually brings a Christmas village, themed markets and tree-lighting shows to the old town and city squares.
activities.priceText: Squares and markets are free to enter (stall food and drink extra)
activities.when: Usually about 6 Dec-6 Jan (2024/25 edition: 6 Dec-6 Jan); 2026 dates not yet published

activities.name: Bari v Monopoli (Serie C) at Stadio San Nicola
activities.blurb: Serie C Group C match in the vast Renzo Piano-designed Stadio San Nicola, now hosting Bari in the third tier.
activities.when: Sun 13 Dec 2026 (Serie C Group C, round 18); kick-off time not yet announced; Stadio San Nicola

activities.name: Bari Cathedral (San Sabino)
activities.blurb: Older than the Basilica of St Nicholas and later refitted in Baroque style; the cathedral is free to enter.

activities.name: Bari Vecchia (Old Town)
activities.blurb: Maze of narrow alleys between the two harbours, with more than 30 churches; free to wander.

activities.name: Basilica di San Nicola
activities.blurb: Romanesque basilica with a gold ceiling and a crypt, home to the magnificent cathedra (bishop's throne) of Bishop Elias.

activities.name: Castello normanno-svevo
activities.blurb: Symbol of Bari: a 12th-century fortress that Frederick II rebuilt in the 13th century.

activities.name: Osteria Vini e Cucina
activities.blurb: Old, very informal trattoria in the old town with traditional, unpretentious cooking; the simple four-course menu is about €15.

activities.name: Venezia 40
activities.blurb: Old-town spot for tasty panzerotti, the small fried filled pastries Bari is known for.

activities.name: Black Lounge bar
activities.blurb: Bar at the exit of Giardino Garibaldi, open daily until 20:00, so more an early-evening stop than a late night.

activities.name: Castello Svevo nightlife area
activities.blurb: The Swabian castle district of the old town is now one of the city's main nightlife areas, with bars around the castle.

activities.name: Lungomare seafront promenade
activities.blurb: Said to be the longest seafront promenade in Italy; a free walk along the Adriatic, good before or after the old town.

activities.name: Winter Wonders Brussels (Plaisirs d'Hiver)
activities.blurb: Brussels' winter festival with hundreds of Christmas chalets from Place Sainte-Catherine to the Bourse, plus shows, attractions and lights.
activities.when: 27 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027 (programme details due from November)

activities.name: RSC Anderlecht v TSG Hoffenheim (UEFA Europa League)
activities.blurb: Europa League night at the stadium of Brussels' most successful club; tickets are sold through the club.

activities.name: RSC Anderlecht v Charleroi (Belgian Pro League)
activities.blurb: Sunday-lunchtime league game at the Anderlecht stadium, three days after the Europa League night.
activities.when: Sun 13 Dec 2026, 13:30 (league fixture list; time may change)

activities.name: Manneken Pis
activities.blurb: Tiny bronze statue of a boy that is the city's cheeky symbol; free, open round the clock and often dressed up.

activities.name: Wiertz Museum
activities.blurb: Former studio of the Romantic painter Antoine Wiertz, kept with its original atmosphere; quirky and free to visit.

activities.name: Royal Museums of Fine Arts of Belgium
activities.blurb: Old Masters such as Bosch and Memling plus the Magritte Museum in one complex; major art at a fair price.
activities.priceText: €8 adults per museum or €13 combo; €2.50 students/seniors/disabled; €1.25 children 12–18; under 12 free; free first Wednesday afternoon of the month

activities.name: Musical Instruments Museum (MIM)
activities.blurb: More than 7,000 instruments from around the world across four floors; an unusual and well-known collection.

activities.name: Waffle Workshop
activities.blurb: A 90-minute hands-on class to make Brussels waffles, with all ingredients and toppings and a take-home recipe.
activities.priceText: General €28, student €25, kids €18, family €75 (2 adults & 2 kids)

activities.name: Friterie Tabora
activities.blurb: Locals' favourite frites stand with a huge range of sauces; open almost round the clock for a cheap bite.

activities.name: Brussels Pub Crawl
activities.blurb: Pub crawl with a free welcome beer, a mini beer tasting and drink discounts, visiting four bars or clubs in one evening.

activities.name: Chez Moeder Lambic
activities.blurb: Old-fashioned brown café with hundreds of obscure Belgian beers, many found nowhere else; a 25 cl beer costs €4.

activities.name: Sandeman's Brussels Free Tours
activities.blurb: Informative three-hour walking tour of the centre on a pay-what-you-wish basis; groups can be large, so arrive early.

activities.name: Nemo 33
activities.blurb: Diving pool 34.5 m deep, filled with non-chlorinated spring water; a unique swim, dive or photo stop.

activities.name: Basler Weihnachtsmarkt (Barfüsserplatz and Münsterplatz)
activities.blurb: One of Switzerland's prettiest Christmas markets, split between Barfüsserplatz and the cathedral square, plus a fairy-tale forest.

activities.name: FC Basel v Servette FC (Super League)
activities.blurb: Sunday-afternoon league game at St. Jakob-Park, Basel's big stadium.
activities.when: Weekend of 5-6 Dec 2026 (official league schedule); fixture sites list Sun 6 Dec, 14:00

activities.name: Basler Münster
activities.blurb: Romanesque-Gothic cathedral above the Rhine; free to enter, and the tower climb for CHF 6 rewards you with a wide view.

activities.name: Antikenmuseum Basel
activities.blurb: Ludwig Collection of antiquities, mostly Greek with some Egyptian and Mesopotamian pieces; open late on Thursdays and Fridays.
activities.when: Tue, Wed, Sat, Sun 11:00-17:00; Thu, Fri 11:00-22:00

activities.name: Kunstmuseum Basel
activities.blurb: Huge collection from Holbein and medieval panels to modernism, including a whole Picasso room; one ticket covers three buildings.

activities.name: Museum Tinguely
activities.blurb: Playful kinetic machines by Jean Tinguely in a Mario Botta building; the moving sculptures are fun for all ages.
activities.priceText: Adults CHF 18; reduced CHF 12; groups from 12 people CHF 12 each

activities.name: Restaurant Zum Braunen Mutz
activities.blurb: Traditional beer hall serving bratwurst with rösti, the local classic, in a no-frills setting; a good place to mix with locals.

activities.name: Brötlibar
activities.blurb: Open-sandwich bar inside the Stadthof hotel on Barfüsserplatz with a big choice of Brötli, the Swiss open sandwich.

activities.name: Hinterhof
activities.blurb: Bar and dance venue with a rooftop, live acts and exhibitions; open since 2011, with frequent parties and no entry fee.
activities.priceText: Frequent parties with no entry fee

activities.name: Verso
activities.blurb: Student-run bar in the university cellar, open Thursday evenings during term; cheap drinks, friendly people and live acts.
activities.when: Thursday evenings during the university lecture period

activities.name: Basel Rhine ferry
activities.blurb: Iconic Rhine ferry crossing that takes only two or three minutes; the view is best on a sunny day.

activities.name: Winter ice rinks: Eglisee and Margarethenpark
activities.blurb: Outdoor rinks open in winter, including Eglisee, on the grounds of the pool of that name, and the Margarethenpark rink.

activities.name: Bratislava Christmas Markets (Bratislavské Vianoce)
activities.blurb: Christmas market on the Main Square plus Franciscan and Primate's squares; opens with the tree lighting and feels small and local.
activities.when: 27 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027 (Main Square, Franciscan Square, Primate's Square)

activities.name: ŠK Slovan Bratislava v Dunajská Streda (Niké liga)
activities.blurb: Saturday-afternoon league game at the national stadium, far cheaper than the Champions League nights.
activities.priceText: EUR 12 (home-fan sector), EUR 16 / 20 / 33 by category; discount cards only for children, pensioners, disabled

activities.name: ŠK Slovan Bratislava v Shakhtar Donetsk (UEFA Champions League)
activities.blurb: Champions League league-phase night at Tehelné pole; tickets sell through the club app, so book early.
activities.priceText: Kotol EUR 48, III. cat. EUR 50, II. cat. EUR 110, I. cat. EUR 175; no discounts for European home games

activities.name: St. Martin's Cathedral
activities.blurb: Gothic cathedral below the castle where Hungarian kings were crowned; entry is a cheap €2 and the interior is worth a look.

activities.name: Bratislava Castle
activities.blurb: Hilltop castle above the Danube with a Bratislava history museum and a baroque garden; the views are the main draw.

activities.name: Michael's Gate with Tower
activities.blurb: 14th-century gate tower, 51 m tall with a green copper roof; one of the oldest landmarks in the old town.

activities.name: Museum of Transport
activities.blurb: Historic cars, trams, bicycles, fire engines and model ships in the city's first railway station, close to the main station.
activities.priceText: Adults €8; students and seniors 65–70 €4; children 3–6 and seniors 70+ €1; under 3 free; free first Wednesday of each month

activities.name: Slovak Pub
activities.blurb: Traditional Slovak eatery on Obchodná serving halušky, the national dish of dumplings; reasonably priced, but portions run small.

activities.name: Góvinda reštaurácia
activities.blurb: Hare Krishna-run vegetarian and vegan canteen in the city centre; very affordable, but open on weekday lunch hours only.

activities.name: UFO
activities.blurb: Bar, lounge and terrace in the saucer on top of the SNP Bridge, with Danube views; the restaurant is pricey.
activities.priceText: Entrance €6.50, but free of charge if you eat in the restaurant

activities.name: KGB Krčma Gurmánov Bratislavy
activities.blurb: Communism-themed pub with good beers at affordable prices in the city centre; a fun, late-running night out.

activities.name: Devín Castle
activities.blurb: Ruined fortress on a rocky hill where the Morava meets the Danube, just outside the city; cheap in winter, with Roman roots.
