activities.name: Underwater Park of Gaiola
activities.blurb: Protected marine area off Posillipo for snorkelling, diving or a glass-bottom boat trip; winter hours still run daily.

activities.name: Nice Christmas Village (Village de Noël)
activities.blurb: Christmas village in the Jardin Albert 1er and on Place Masséna, open every day and free to enter.

activities.name: OGC Nice v RC Lens (Ligue 1)
activities.blurb: Saturday league game at the Allianz Riviera, west of the city; kick-off time to be set by the league.
activities.when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (Ligue 1 matchday 14; kick-off time to be confirmed)

activities.name: Colline du Château
activities.blurb: Hilltop park with the ruins of an old castle and a spectacular free viewpoint over the Baie des Anges and the harbour.

activities.name: Musée des Arts Asiatiques
activities.blurb: Free Asian art museum in a striking building beside a lake, with Indian, Chinese and Southeast Asian works and world art.

activities.name: Musée Marc Chagall
activities.blurb: Stained-glass windows and large Chagall paintings in a Cimiez museum; a must-see even for people who don't follow art.
activities.priceText: Full €8, reduced €6; free for students below 26 and on the first Sunday of the month

activities.name: Musée Matisse
activities.blurb: Matisse paintings, drawings and sculptures in a 17th-century Genoese villa in Cimiez; a compact, charming collection.
activities.priceText: Full €10; groups of 10+ €8; students and under-18s free with proof of eligibility

activities.name: Flower Market (Marché aux Fleurs)
activities.blurb: Old Town street market that began as a flower market; now mostly produce, bakes and souvenirs, and open on Sunday mornings.

activities.name: Lou Pilha Leva
activities.blurb: Old Town counter spot serving socca, Nice's chickpea flatbread, at a very low price; order at the counter and eat it on the go.

activities.name: Ma Nolan's
activities.blurb: Irish pub next to the opera in Old Town with live music every night, sport on four screens and good food.

activities.name: Le Blue Whales
activities.blurb: Rock-leaning pub since 1993 with live music, sport on screen, Wednesday trivia at 20:00 and pub grub; lively late.

activities.name: Cliff Walk (Sentier Littoral)
activities.blurb: Coastal path around Cap de Nice toward Villefranche; expect several hundred steps, but it is free and used mostly by locals.

activities.name: Parc Phoenix
activities.blurb: Botanical garden with about 2,500 plant species, a tropical glasshouse and some animals; a warm break on a grey winter day.
activities.priceText: €5.20; ages 12-18 €3; under 12 free; Nice museums pass-holders €3

activities.name: Nuremberg Christkindlesmarkt
activities.blurb: Famous market on the Hauptmarkt with 180+ booths and endless gingerbread; the Christkind appears there Tue–Fri at 15:00.
activities.when: 27 Nov–24 Dec 2026, daily 10:00–21:00 (24 Dec to 14:00); opened by the Christkind's prologue on 27 Nov

activities.name: 1. FC Nürnberg vs VfL Bochum (2. Bundesliga)
activities.blurb: Second-division home game for the Club (1. FC Nürnberg); the exact kick-off day and time are still to be set.
activities.when: Sun 6 Dec 2026 (matchday 14; kick-off not yet scheduled, weekend of 4–6 Dec)

activities.name: St Sebald Church
activities.blurb: Romanesque church from the 13th century with later Gothic and Baroque additions, on the north side of the old town; free to enter.

activities.name: Nuremberg Castle (Imperial Castle)
activities.blurb: Hilltop fortress dominating the old town, made of three distinct parts that once stood in conflict; visit with the combined ticket.
activities.priceText: Combination ticket 10 € regular, 9 € reduced (official site); single sites 7 € and 4 €

activities.name: Memorium Nuremberg Trials
activities.blurb: Courtroom 600 in the Palace of Justice, where the Nazi high command was tried after WWII; an audio guide is included.

activities.name: Germanisches Nationalmuseum
activities.blurb: One of the largest museums of art and crafts in German-speaking countries, from prehistoric finds to 20th-century art; allow half a day.

activities.name: Red Curry House
activities.blurb: Small South-East Asian dishes at low prices, good value for money; closed on Sundays and public holidays.
activities.when: Mon–Sat 11:30–20:30; closed Sun and public holidays

activities.name: Historische Bratwurstküche (Zum Guldenen Stern)
activities.blurb: Timber-framed sausage restaurant that claims to be the world's oldest, since 1419; order six or ten grilled sausages.

activities.name: Mata Hari Bar
activities.blurb: Small, packed bar where it's easy to strike up conversation, especially if you're on your own; good for long evenings.

activities.name: Die Rakete
activities.blurb: Small electronic-music club that is a regional institution, known well beyond Nuremberg.

activities.name: Nurembergs Underworld (Felsengänge)
activities.blurb: Guided tours through sandstone cellars under the castle hill, including old beer cellars and WWII air-raid shelters.
activities.when: Tours hourly or two-hourly daily; English tours Sat and Sun at 11:15

activities.name: Langwasserbad
activities.blurb: Large indoor pool with a sauna and wellness areas, open daily; towels, slippers and drinks are not included and swimwear is required.

activities.name: Natal no Porto (Aliados lights, Cordoaria market, ice rink)
activities.blurb: Christmas lights and tree on Avenida dos Aliados with open-air concerts, a market in Jardim da Cordoaria and an ice rink.
activities.priceText: Lights and the Tenda de Natal are free; ice rink and carousel prices not stated
activities.when: 2025: lights 29 Nov-6 Jan, Cordoaria market to 30 Dec; 2026 programme TBA

activities.name: FC Porto v Estrela Amadora (Liga Portugal)
activities.blurb: FC Porto's home game on Liga Portugal matchday 14 at the Estádio do Dragão; day and kick-off still to be set.
activities.when: Liga Portugal matchday 14, listed Sun 13 Dec 2026; kick-off TBA

activities.name: Livraria Lello
activities.blurb: Ornate bookshop with a spiral staircase, voted among Europe's most beautiful; very crowded inside.
activities.priceText: €10 online ticket, €12 at the entrance; the ticket can be used towards books (Wikivoyage)

activities.name: Palácio da Bolsa
activities.blurb: Stock Exchange Palace: the Arab Room is the highlight, plus a port-wine tasting room.
activities.priceText: Individual €14; reduced €9.50 for students, school groups and seniors (official page)

activities.name: Centro Português de Fotografia
activities.blurb: Free photography museum in a beautiful building in the city centre.

activities.name: Fundação de Serralves
activities.blurb: Contemporary museum by Álvaro Siza, with a large park, an Art Deco villa and a restaurant.
activities.priceText: €8.50 museum and park; €4 park only; free Sundays 10:00–13:00 for students and under-18s; 50% off 65+ and Porto card holders (Wikivoyage)

activities.name: Mercado do Bolhão
activities.blurb: Traditional market of fruit, vegetables, fish and meat, fully reopened after major refurbishment in 2022.

activities.name: Casa das Tortas
activities.blurb: Homemade Portuguese food and bakery pastries; Wikivoyage calls its francesinha the best in Porto.

activities.name: Prioridade Bar
activities.blurb: Ribeira bar where a large beer costs only a few euros, one of the cheapest in the area.
activities.priceText: Large beer for only a few euros (Wikivoyage)

activities.name: Industria
activities.blurb: Dance club running since 1987, open until around 06:00.

activities.name: Fado Bars (Porto)
activities.blurb: Traditional fado sung by a woman in a black dress with guitar players; a handful of fado bars in Porto.

activities.name: Douro river cruise
activities.blurb: About 50-minute boat trip upriver on the Douro; most operators sail every 30 minutes between 10:00 and 18:30.

activities.name: Tuileries Christmas Market and Champs-Élysées Christmas Market
activities.blurb: Chalets, rides and treats in the Tuileries Garden, with a second market on the Champs-Élysées just next door.
activities.priceText: Free entry; rides and food extra
activities.when: Tuileries reported 14 Nov 2026-3 Jan 2027; organiser dates not yet confirmed

activities.name: Paris Saint-Germain v Paris FC (Ligue 1)
activities.blurb: Saturday league game at the Parc des Princes against the other Paris club; kick-off time to be set by the league.
activities.when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (Ligue 1 matchday 14; kick-off time to be confirmed)

activities.name: Paris Basketball v Real Madrid (EuroLeague)
activities.blurb: EuroLeague night for the Paris club against Real Madrid; the league lists the Adidas Arena, but check the club for the final venue.

activities.name: Paris Basketball v Olympiacos (EuroLeague)
activities.blurb: EuroLeague game for the Paris club against Olympiacos; check the club site for the arena and tickets.

activities.name: Notre-Dame de Paris
activities.blurb: Gothic cathedral on the Île de la Cité; entry is free, but booking ahead saves a long queue.
activities.priceText: Free; booking recommended as queues can be long

activities.name: Musée d'Art Moderne de la Ville de Paris
activities.blurb: Free city collection of modern art from World War I onwards, in the east wing of the Palais de Tokyo; temporary shows charge extra.
activities.priceText: Free; temporary exhibitions have various charges

activities.name: Musée d'Orsay
activities.blurb: Former 1900 railway station with a rich Impressionist and Post-Impressionist collection; the great hall alone is worth the visit.
activities.priceText: €9; concessions €6.50; under 18 or 26 for EU member states free

activities.name: Musée du Louvre
activities.blurb: Enormous museum spanning ancient Egypt, Greece and Rome, medieval Europe and Napoleonic France; pick a few wings, not all of it.
activities.priceText: €22 for EEA residents/nationals, €32 for others; EEA nationals aged 18-25 free with photo ID

activities.name: Marché d'Aligre
activities.blurb: Paris's cheapest open-air market with produce, clothes and antiques; the covered Beauvau market and food shops are next door.

activities.name: Chez Marianne
activities.blurb: Pletzl institution: falafel sandwiches from the walk-up window for a few euros, plus a sit-down room with cheap vegetarian menus.
activities.priceText: Falafel out of the window €4; dining room about €15 for a vegetarian menu, up to €22 à la carte

activities.name: Le Piano Vache
activities.blurb: Long-running student bar in the Latin Quarter, walls covered in band posters and regulars' passport photos; cheap beer.

activities.name: Nouveau Casino et Café Charbon
activities.blurb: Downstairs bar and upstairs dance hall in Oberkampf that rocks until dawn; a favourite with young Parisians after other places close.

activities.name: Canal Saint-Martin promenade
activities.blurb: Leisurely stroll along the canal with cafés and pastry stops; a cheap way to feel local, with lovely sunsets.

activities.name: Public swimming pool and ice rink, La Défense
activities.blurb: Public pool complex in the La Défense business district with a winter ice rink; no price or hours are listed, so check first.

activities.name: Fira de Nadal i dels Reis (Palma Christmas fair)
activities.blurb: Palma's Christmas fair: nativity-figure stalls on Plaça Major, craft stalls on La Rambla and a giant tree at Parc de ses Estacions.
activities.priceText: Free to walk around; purchases extra
activities.when: Daily 10:00-21:00; 2025 ran 22 Nov-7 Jan; 2026 dates TBA

activities.name: Banys Àrabs
activities.blurb: Tenth-century bathhouse with under-floor heating, the only building in Palma from the Arab period; small and cheap.

activities.name: Castell de Bellver
activities.blurb: Unusual circular 14th-century castle built over a Moorish fort; it withstood two sieges and holds a museum.

activities.name: Royal Palace of La Almudaina
activities.blurb: Fortress with Roman roots and a 1309 rebuild; its upper floor holds grand 16th-century state rooms.
activities.priceText: Adult €8, concession €5 (Wikivoyage; official ticket page showed no prices)

activities.name: Palma Cathedral (La Seu)
activities.blurb: Gothic cathedral begun in 1229; Gaudí tried to improve it and quit, and the Royal Chapel holds royal tombs.

activities.name: Calixto
activities.blurb: Paella is the whole menu, and it's good; a simple place to eat the dish in Palma.

activities.name: Boira Restaurante
activities.blurb: Mediterranean cooking at good value, served from breakfast until late evening.

activities.name: Abaco
activities.blurb: Over-the-top cocktail bar in a former coaching house with no food; on Fridays the music builds to a crescendo.

activities.name: Gibson Bar
activities.blurb: City-centre bar named in Wikivoyage's December nightlife tips; the source gives no hours or prices.

activities.name: Palma Aquarium
activities.blurb: Aquarium of Mediterranean and coastal ecosystems with a huge shark tank and many live corals; booking advised.

activities.name: Biancaneve (Snow White) ballet at Teatro Massimo
activities.blurb: Three-act Snow White to Rachmaninov by the Teatro Massimo ballet and orchestra, in Palermo's lavish opera house.
activities.priceText: Cheapest seats (sector 8) about EUR 16-22 depending on the date, sector 1 up to EUR 110; reduced -20% for eligible groups; plus 10% booking fee
activities.when: 15 Dec 20:00, 16 Dec 18:30, 17 Dec 19:00, 18 Dec 18:30, then 19-23 Dec (no show 21 Dec); single tickets on sale from 13 Nov 2026

activities.name: Nuovo Cinema Paradiso with live orchestra, Teatro Massimo
activities.blurb: Tornatore's film screened with Morricone's score played live by the Teatro Massimo orchestra in Palermo's grand opera house.
activities.priceText: 2026/27 concert price list: EUR 20 (sector 8) to EUR 35 (sector 1); reduced EUR 16-28 for eligible groups (e.g. Palermo students, 'up to 26'); Card Under35 EUR
activities.when: Fri 4 and Sat 5 Dec 2026, 20:30, Sala Grande; single tickets on sale from 31 Oct 2026

activities.name: Palermo v Cremonese (Serie B) at Stadio Renzo Barbera
activities.blurb: Midweek Serie B game on the Immaculate Conception holiday at the Barbera, home of the rosanero and their loud curve.
activities.priceText: Curve EUR 26 on the club's Oct 2026 home-match list (Palermo-Carrarese); Gradinata Superiore EUR 35, Tribuna Laterale EUR 50; prices for this match not yet publ
activities.when: Tue 8 Dec 2026 (Serie B round 16); kick-off time not yet announced; Stadio Renzo Barbera

activities.name: Piazza Pretoria
activities.blurb: Fountain square with 16 nude statues of nymphs and figures, also called the square of shame; free to walk around.

activities.name: Catacombe dei Cappuccini
activities.blurb: Capuchin catacombs with over 8,000 mummified former residents; some are clothed skeletons, others strikingly well preserved.

activities.name: Palazzo dei Normanni and Cappella Palatina
activities.blurb: Former royal palace of the Norman kings; the Cappella Palatina inside is an Arab-Norman mosaic chapel and a must-see.

activities.name: Palermo Cathedral
activities.blurb: Honey-coloured, Catalan-influenced cathedral where Emperor Frederick II is buried, in a porphyry sarcophagus.

activities.name: Il Proverbio
activities.blurb: Sicilian food near the station and Quattro Canti; the listing says most dishes are cheap at €4–6.

activities.name: Pani câ Meusa – Porta Carbone
activities.blurb: Classic Palermo street-food sandwiches from a stall near Porta Carbone; the listing rates them among the best in town.

activities.name: dal Barone
activities.blurb: Relaxed wine bar with a good selection of wines and good cheeseboards; open evenings Monday to Saturday.

activities.name: The Bar Brothers
activities.blurb: Small bar for beers and cocktails, with a few seats out on the street; open Wednesday to Sunday evenings.

activities.name: Monreale Cathedral (day trip)
activities.blurb: Norman cathedral begun in 1174, on a hill 8 km west of Palermo with views back over the city and the sea.

activities.name: Poznań Christmas Market (Betlejem Poznańskie, Old Market Square)
activities.blurb: Christmas fair on Poznań's Old Market Square, with craft stalls, food and mulled wine.
activities.when: Planned 21 Nov 2026–6 Jan 2027 (dates exclude set-up and dismantling)

activities.name: Lech Poznań vs Ferencváros (UEFA Europa League)
activities.blurb: European night at Enea Stadion as Lech host Hungary's Ferencváros in the Europa League league phase.
activities.priceText: PLN 140 normal in the cheapest category (Białasa i Kocioł stands); reduced PLN 112 for students aged 13–26

activities.name: Stary Rynek (Old Market Square)
activities.blurb: Medieval square rebuilt after WWII destruction, lined with cafés and bars; one of the finest in Europe and the heart of the old town.

activities.name: Town Hall (Ratusz)
activities.blurb: Gothic town hall later rebuilt in Renaissance style; the centrepiece of the Rynek, with a small entry fee.

activities.name: Museum of Musical Instruments
activities.blurb: Some 2,000 instruments from around the world, the only collection of its kind in Poland, plus a large Chopin memorabilia section.

activities.name: Brama Poznania (ICHOT)
activities.blurb: Interactive exhibition on Cathedral Island's history and the founding of Poznań, with an audioguide and a rooftop view.

activities.name: Dramat
activities.blurb: Cheap, perennially popular Polish eatery on the Rynek, good for a budget meal in the Old Town.

activities.name: Pierogarnia Stary Młyn
activities.blurb: Rustic pierogi house with sweet, sour, meat and vegan fillings, plus bigos and żurek; a proper Polish meal.

activities.name: Kultowa
activities.blurb: Smoky, brick-walled pub playing 80s and 90s Polish rock hits; a slower, relaxed night out.

activities.name: Cuba Libre
activities.blurb: Latin music bar where the owner often gives a short salsa lesson before the DJ-led Latin parties start.

activities.name: Morasko Meteorite Nature Reserve
activities.blurb: Nature reserve on the city edge with seven craters left by a meteorite fall thousands of years ago; a free walk outdoors.

activities.name: Termy Maltańskie
activities.blurb: One of Poland's largest aquaparks, with a wave pool and many slides; sauna and sports-pool zones are paid separately.
activities.when: Aquapark daily 09:00–23:00; sauna zone Mon–Fri 14:30–23:00, Sat–Sun 11:30–23:00 (official site)

activities.name: Prague Christmas Markets (Old Town Square and Wenceslas Square)
activities.blurb: Giant tree, wooden stalls and mulled wine on Old Town Square, plus a second market on Wenceslas Square; open daily into January.
activities.priceText: Free entry; food and drink typically EUR 15-20 per person
activities.when: Usually from the last weekend of Nov to 6 Jan, about 9:00-22:00 daily; 2026 dates not yet published

activities.name: AC Sparta Praha v FK Mladá Boleslav (Chance Liga)
activities.blurb: Saturday-evening league game at Sparta's epet ARENA on Letná hill; a cheap way to see Czech top-flight football.
activities.priceText: CZK 350-1,200 depending on match category and sector (cheapest listed CZK 350)

activities.name: SK Slavia Praha v FC Slovan Liberec (Chance Liga)
activities.blurb: Sunday-evening home game of Prague's other big club at the Fortuna Arena in Eden; kick-off 18:00.

activities.name: Prague Castle
activities.blurb: Hilltop castle complex with St Vitus Cathedral and Golden Lane; go early to beat the crowds.

activities.name: Speculum Alchemiae
activities.blurb: Tiny alchemy museum in a house said to date from 980 AD, in the old Jewish Quarter; quirky, cheap and off the beaten track.

activities.name: Mucha Museum
activities.blurb: Works of Art Nouveau master Alphonse Mucha, from his famous posters to paintings, in a compact museum in the New Town.
activities.priceText: Adult 300 Kč; children, students and seniors 220 Kč

activities.name: Museum of Communism
activities.blurb: Walks through Czech communist history up to the 1989 Velvet Revolution, with propaganda art and everyday objects on display.
activities.priceText: Adults 390 Kč, students with ID 310 Kč, seniors 340 Kč

activities.name: Lokál
activities.blurb: Modern take on a Czech beer hall: cheap Pilsner and hearty traditional dishes in a bright, busy room in the Old Town.

activities.name: Kantýna
activities.blurb: Grab a tray and pile on meat cuts and sides at the counters, paying by weight; a lively, market-style lunch or dinner.

activities.name: Chateau Rouge
activities.blurb: Three-floor Old Town club with free entry, cheap Staropramen and a steady flow of tourists and pub-crawl groups.

activities.name: U Fleků
activities.blurb: Historic brewery restaurant that brews its own dark, sweet beer; a classic old-school Prague beer hall night out.
activities.priceText: U Fleků 13° 99 Kč and spirits around 79 Kč

activities.name: Staropramen Brewery Visitor Center
activities.blurb: Tour Prague's best-known brewery, founded in 1869, with English-language tours and a restaurant on the same site.

activities.name: Kawkab Marrakech home match (Botola Pro)
activities.blurb: Top-flight Moroccan football in Marrakech: Kawkab host Botola Pro games, but the December fixture list is not published yet.
activities.priceText: MAD 30 (Kawkab supporters' stands), MAD 100 (West stand), MAD 200 (VIP) at the Kawkab v Wydad match in April 2026; varies by opponent
activities.when: Home date not published yet; Botola Pro runs from 24 Sep 2026 and fixtures come out in blocks (placeholder window)

activities.name: Djemaa El-Fna
activities.blurb: Medina's main square, the highlight of any Marrakech night: storytellers, musicians and food stalls.
activities.when: Open all day; best in the evening

activities.name: The Souks
activities.blurb: Market lanes beside Djemaa El-Fna selling spices, leather, lamps and clothes; haggle hard, as tourists are often quoted higher prices.
activities.when: Daytime and evening; hours not listed

activities.name: Ben Youssef Madrasa
activities.blurb: One of North Africa's largest madrasas, completed in 1564-65 and full of decorative art; cheap to visit.
activities.priceText: 50 dirham adult; children under 12 10 dirham; groups over 20 pay 30 dirham each

activities.name: Bahia Palace
activities.blurb: Late-19th-century palace of courtyards, gardens and richly decorated rooms; a good look at Moroccan architecture.

activities.name: Saadian Tombs
activities.blurb: Royal necropolis of the 16th-century Saadian dynasty, with decorated chambers such as the Chamber of the Twelve Columns.

activities.name: Majorelle Gardens
activities.blurb: Cobalt-blue garden and studio created by painter Jacques Majorelle; tickets are sold online only.
activities.priceText: 170 dirham; 30 dirham extra for the Berber Museum

activities.name: Yves Saint Laurent Museum
activities.blurb: Museum dedicated to designer Yves Saint Laurent; ticket queues are shorter than at Majorelle, but tickets must be booked online.
activities.priceText: 120 dirham; combination ticket with Majorelle Gardens and Berber Museum 180 dirham

activities.name: Chez Chegrouni
activities.blurb: Budget couscous house known for its vegetarian version and very generous portions; usually full of tourists.

activities.name: Chesterfield Pub
activities.blurb: Odd 'English pub' in a palm-tree courtyard with an outdoor pool; serves Moroccan lager to a mostly local crowd.

activities.name: Hamam Essalama
activities.blurb: Basic local hammam where entry is cheap and a scrub costs extra; staff speak neither English nor French.

activities.name: Imagine Peace Tower (nightly light beam from Viðey)
activities.blurb: Yoko Ono's beam of light rises from Viðey Island every evening in December; watch it from the Reykjavík waterfront.
activities.when: Lit nightly 1-30 Dec, 18:00-midnight (31 Dec until morning)

activities.name: Hafnarfjörður Christmas Village (Jólaþorpið)
activities.blurb: Little village of Christmas huts south of Reykjavík with live music, visits from the Yule Lads and horse-drawn carriage rides.
activities.when: Usually every Saturday and Sunday 12:00-17:00 during Advent; 2026 dates not yet published

activities.name: Reykjavík city-centre Christmas markets and Ingólfstorg ice rink
activities.blurb: December markets around Austurvöllur and Hjartatorg plus a skating rink on Ingólfstorg, a few minutes' walk apart.
activities.priceText: Free entry to markets; ice rink is ticketed
activities.when: December; 2026 dates not yet published (2025: Hjartatorg market 5-6, 12-13, 18-23 Dec)

activities.name: Hallgrímskirkja church tower
activities.blurb: Hilltop church with a tower and a wide view over Reykjavík; the Leif Eriksson statue stands out front.
activities.priceText: Tower: adults 1300 kr, students 1000 kr, children (7-14) 200 kr

activities.name: 871±2 Settlement Exhibition
activities.blurb: Interactive exhibition built around Iceland's oldest archaeological ruins, dating to about 870; a quick, cheap look at the first settlers.

activities.name: Reykjavík Art Museum - Hafnarhús
activities.blurb: Harbourside art museum with rotating shows of Erró and changing Icelandic artists; one ticket covers three art museums.
activities.priceText: Adults 2200 kr, students 1370 kr, under 18 free; covers Hafnarhús, Kjarvalsstaðir and Ásmundarsafn

activities.name: National Museum of Iceland
activities.blurb: Walks you through the nation's history from the first settlers to today; a good background before exploring the rest of the island.
activities.priceText: Adults 3,300 kr; students and seniors 1,600 kr; under 18 and disabled visitors free

activities.name: Sægreifinn
activities.blurb: Very authentic harbour seafood counter known for lobster soup, with grilled cod, shrimp and salmon; from about 800 kr a dish.

activities.name: Bæjarins beztu pylsur
activities.blurb: Reykjavík's famous hot dog stand, open round the clock; the queues say it all, and a hot dog is cheap compared with most meals.

activities.name: Ölstofa Kormáks og Skjaldar (Ölstofan)
activities.blurb: Small, cosy, very popular bar decorated like an Icelandic grandmother's living room, with its own house beer.

activities.name: Kaffibarinn
activities.blurb: Club in a red two-storey timber house since the 1980s; a long-running favourite for dancing and late nights.

activities.name: Grótta island
activities.blurb: Small island at the western tip of the peninsula, reachable on foot at low tide; a quiet walk. Check tide times first.
activities.when: Open most of the year; closed 1 May-15 Jul

activities.name: Laugardalslaug
activities.blurb: Reykjavík's largest pool complex: hot pots, a seawater bath, a steam room and a water slide; a cheap, warming winter treat.

activities.name: Riga Old Town Christmas Market (Doma Square)
activities.blurb: Old Town Christmas market on Doma Square with wooden huts, gingerbread, Santa's cabin, a carousel and evening concerts.

activities.name: Latvian National Opera and Ballet: Giselle, Aida and Carmen nights
activities.blurb: Opera and ballet evenings in Riga's national theatre; the Nutcracker runs 5–18 Dec but all its dates are sold out.
activities.when: Giselle 10 Dec, Aida 11 Dec, Carmen 17 Dec 2026 (all 19:00); Midsummer Night's Dream ballet 9 Dec

activities.name: Triangula Bastion
activities.blurb: Modern building that exposes a fragment of the old fortification wall; reputed to have Riga's finest viewing terraces.

activities.name: St. Peter's Church
activities.blurb: Riga's first church, dating from 1209; a lift climbs its tower for views across the city.
activities.when: Tower lift not available on Mondays

activities.name: Latvian National Museum of Art
activities.blurb: The country's leading art collection, with many works by Latvian artists.

activities.name: House of the Blackheads (Melngalvju nams)
activities.blurb: Riga merchants' guild house with upper ballrooms and a museum; part of the building is the tourist office.

activities.name: Vermanitis
activities.blurb: Budget Latvian restaurant in an 'authentic' setting in Riga's Centrs district: fried fish, half chicken and cheap beer.
activities.priceText: Fried fish €3, salmon steak €5, half chicken €2.50, 500 ml beer €2.10

activities.name: Alus Arsenals
activities.blurb: Snug cellar restaurant by Riga Castle: meat and fish plates and well-made local beers.

activities.name: Pūce

activities.name: Marjan hill walk

activities.name: Stortorget Christmas Market (Gamla Stan)

activities.name: Christmas Market at Skansen
activities.blurb: Weekend Christmas market inside the Skansen open-air museum, among relocated historic wooden buildings.

activities.name: Storkyrkan (Stockholm Cathedral)

activities.name: Royal Palace (Kungliga Slottet)

activities.name: Nationalmuseum (National Museum of Fine Arts)

activities.name: Vasa Museum

activities.name: Vete-Katten

activities.name: Stampen
activities.blurb: Gamla stan jazz venue dating from 1965, with live acts on most nights.

activities.name: Old Town free walking tour (Stockholm Free Tour)

activities.name: Storkyrkobadet
activities.blurb: Hidden pool and sauna in a former Old Town wine cellar, bathing beneath 1700s vaults; men and women go on separate days.

activities.name: Seville Christmas markets and street lights

activities.name: El Librero Tapas y Quesos

activities.name: La Carbonería
activities.blurb: Bar with free flamenco shows every night at 21:30, 22:30 and 23:30; arrive early for seats.

activities.name: Cafe-Bar Las Teresas
activities.blurb: Lively cured-ham bar open late, popular with both locals and tourists.

activities.name: Museo del Baile Flamenco

activities.name: Parc de l'Orangerie

activities.blurb: Salzburg's classic Advent market around the cathedral squares, with wooden huts, choirs, tower music and Krampus visits.

activities.name: Red Bull Salzburg v Sparta Praha (UEFA Europa League)

activities.name: Salzburg Cathedral (Salzburger Dom)

activities.when: Sat 12 to Sat 19 Dec 2026 (dates announced by the Ministry of Culture on 12 May 2026)

activities.name: Espérance de Tunis v Zarzis (Ligue 1)
activities.blurb: Home league game for Tunisia's most successful club at the 65,000-seat Radès stadium; the kick-off time is a placeholder.
activities.when: Sat 12 Dec 2026, 16:30 (per FotMob; the league can reschedule), Stade Hammadi-Agrebi, Radès

activities.name: Club Africain v JS Omrane (Ligue 1)
activities.blurb: Club Africain home league game at the Radès stadium, the Tunis rival of Espérance; date and time can still change.
activities.when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 16:30 (per FotMob; the league can reschedule), Stade Hammadi-Agrebi, Radès

activities.name: Tunis Medina
activities.blurb: UNESCO-listed old town of narrow lanes, decorated houses, vaults and vendors; walk only, and get lost on purpose.

activities.name: Bab El Bahr
activities.blurb: Sea gate of 1848 on Avenue de France; its site once had the Mediterranean on one side and Lake Tunis on the other.

activities.name: Uthina Roman ruins
activities.blurb: Roman-Berber city ruins outside Tunis: theatre, amphitheatre, triumphal arch and many mosaics; a day trip.

activities.name: Dar Ben Abdallah Museum
activities.blurb: Folk museum in an 18th-century medina palace, showing a rich merchant's Ottoman-era life through faience, costumes and furniture.

activities.name: Bardo Museum
activities.blurb: Former bey's palace renowned for its Roman mosaics; the collection covers prehistory through the Ottoman period.

activities.name: Halfaouine food market
activities.blurb: Cheap, traditional food market at Place Halfaouine near the railway station; good for a simple local meal.

activities.name: La Sirène
activities.blurb: Pick your fish at the market counter and it is fried on the spot; water views, but it fills up, so expect a wait.

activities.name: Le Boeuf sur le Toit
activities.blurb: Trendy spot for food, drinks, live music and DJs, with a dance floor; its name means 'the Ox on the Roof'.

activities.name: Bar Jamaica
activities.blurb: Funky bar on the 10th floor of Hotel el-Hana International, with music and outdoor seating; locals and foreigners mix.

activities.name: Panorama Medina
activities.blurb: Decorated tea house with a big rooftop over the medina and its mosques; cheap tea and shisha.
activities.priceText: DT2 for tea, DT5 for shisha

activities.name: Marunouchi Illumination 2026-27
activities.blurb: Winter light-up along the Marunouchi avenue beside Tokyo Station, free to walk through every evening.
activities.when: 12 Nov 2026 to 14 Feb 2027 per a season guide; evening hours not yet published (2025/26: 16:00-23:00)

activities.name: Roppongi Hills Keyakizaka Illumination and Christmas Market
activities.blurb: Zelkova-lined Keyakizaka street lit up with Tokyo Tower in view; a Christmas market runs nearby at O-yane Plaza.
activities.priceText: Illumination street is free, no ticket needed; market entry not stated
activities.when: Illumination 5 Nov to 25 Dec 2026, 17:00-22:00; market 21 Nov to 25 Dec, 11:00-21:00 (per a 2026-27 season guide)

activities.name: Midtown Christmas 2026 (Tokyo Midtown, Roppongi)
activities.blurb: Free evening Christmas light displays in the Midtown Garden, plus a paid ice rink from 5 December.
activities.priceText: Free, no reservation; the ice rink is paid (price not stated)
activities.when: 26 Nov to 25 Dec 2026, 17:00-23:00; ice rink 5 Dec 2026 to 23 Feb 2027, 11:00-21:00 (per a 2026-27 season guide)

activities.name: Shibuya Blue Cave (Ao no Dokutsu)
activities.blurb: Walk-through tunnel of blue LED lights in Shibuya, a free evening stroll that gets very crowded at weekends.

activities.name: Setagaya Boroichi (street flea market)
activities.blurb: Centuries-old two-day street market of used kimono, antiques and street food; the ward counts about 200,000 visitors a day.
activities.priceText: Free to enter; stalls sell second-hand goods and food
activities.when: Tue 15 and Wed 16 Dec 2026 (held every 15-16 Dec and 15-16 Jan), 09:00-20:00; no parking

activities.name: Meiji Jingu shrine
activities.blurb: Tokyo's grandest Shinto shrine in Harajuku, built in 1920 to commemorate Emperor Meiji; entry to the shrine is free.

activities.name: Sensō-ji temple, Asakusa
activities.blurb: Asakusa's main temple; the main hall opens early and closes at 17:00, so an early start works well.
activities.when: Main hall 06:30–17:00 Oct–Mar, 06:00–17:00 other months; grounds hours not listed

activities.name: National Museum of Western Art
activities.blurb: Western art, including the original Rodin The Thinker, in a Le Corbusier building that is on the UNESCO World Heritage list.
activities.priceText: ¥500 adult; ¥250 university or college student (permanent collection)

activities.name: Asakura Museum of Sculpture
activities.blurb: Sculptor Asakura Fumio's house and studio in Taito, with a garden and a vaulted studio hall; small and atmospheric.
activities.priceText: Adult ¥500, student ¥250 (Wikivoyage; ID rule not stated)

activities.name: Edo-Tokyo Museum
activities.blurb: Striking building raised above the ground to resemble an old warehouse, covering Tokyo's history from 1590; a long, rich visit.
activities.priceText: Adult ¥1,300; university student with ID ¥1,040; younger students with ID free (Wikivoyage)

activities.name: Tsukiji Outer Market
activities.blurb: Food-shop lanes that stayed behind when the wholesale fish market moved to Toyosu in 2018.
activities.when: Mon–Sat about 09:00–14:00 (varies by shop); closed most Wednesdays and holidays

activities.name: Kagetsudo
activities.blurb: Melon pan bakery making its buttery, crisp-topped cakes since 1945, with the decor unchanged; a cheap snack stop.

activities.name: Abbott's Choice
activities.blurb: Small Roppongi bar with NYC pop on the radio and a mix of tourists, expats and locals; a respite from pricier bars nearby.

activities.name: Hair of the Dogs
activities.blurb: Punk-rock bar in Shinjuku with a Mexican wrestler theme; the cover buys a bar seat, and you pick the music from a menu.
activities.priceText: ¥800 to sit at the bar (cover); drinks average ¥700

activities.name: Ōi Racecourse
activities.blurb: Major horse-racing track with night racing from March to December and a Grade I race in December; cheap entry and food stalls.
activities.when: Night races March–December; daily hours not listed

activities.name: Venezia. It's Christmas Time (lights, San Marco tree, ice rinks)
activities.blurb: City-run festive season: lights across the lagoon city, a big tree in Piazza San Marco and an ice rink in Campo San Polo.
activities.priceText: Lights and installations free to see; ice rink prices not stated
activities.when: 2025-26: 21 Nov-6 Jan, tree lit 22 Nov, rink from 29 Nov; 2026 dates TBA

activities.name: Venezia v Sassuolo (Serie A)
activities.blurb: Venezia FC host Sassuolo at the small Stadio Penzo on Serie A matchday 14, a Monday 18:30 kick-off.

activities.name: St Mark's Basilica (Basilica di San Marco)
activities.blurb: Golden Byzantine-style basilica on Piazza San Marco; free to enter if you dress modestly, with fees for the upper museum and treasury.
activities.priceText: Basilica free; upper museum €5; high altar €2; treasury €3

activities.name: Santa Maria Gloriosa dei Frari
activities.blurb: Huge Venetian Gothic friary church with Titian's Assunta and works by Bellini and Donatello; a cheap, big-name sight.

activities.name: Doge's Palace (Palazzo Ducale)
activities.blurb: Gothic seat of the Venetian doges; the Secret Itinerary guided tour reaches the administrative rooms and Casanova's former jail.

activities.name: Gallerie dell'Accademia
activities.blurb: Venice's leading art museum, strong on Venetian painters such as Bellini and Tintoretto; reservations cost an extra €1.50.

activities.name: Cantine del Vino già Schiavi
activities.blurb: Inventive cicchetti: pile a plate with what you like and staff pour a matching glass of wine; step outside by the canal if full.

activities.name: Al Vecio Canton
activities.blurb: Small, atmospheric Castello pizzeria famous for traditional pizza and seafood pasta at affordable prices.

activities.name: Osteria da Filo
activities.blurb: Cheap aperitivo bar popular with local students, with €2.50 spritzes and live music from time to time.

activities.name: Chet Bar
activities.blurb: Venice's nearest thing to a dive bar, open daily until 02:00, with cocktails better than the décor suggests.

activities.name: Venice Casino (Casinò di Venezia)
activities.blurb: Oldest gambling house in the world (1638), in a 15th-century building; entry is free when booked through selected hotels.
activities.priceText: Entrance €10, free if booked at selected hotels

activities.name: Northern Giudecca canal walk
activities.blurb: Long, sunny walk along the Giudecca canal, sheltered from winter northerly winds; you can stop by a gondola yard on the way.

activities.name: Vienna Christmas Market at the City Hall (Rathausplatz)
activities.blurb: Vienna's largest Christmas market on the Rathausplatz, with stalls, hot punch and an ice-skating rink in the park alongside.
activities.priceText: Free entry; skating at the Ice Dream rink is extra

activities.name: Christmas Market at Schönbrunn Palace
activities.blurb: Over 90 huts in the palace's front courtyard, with ice-stock shooting, a crafts hut and a nativity display; pretty when lit at night.
activities.priceText: Free entry; ice-stock shooting and activities extra
activities.when: 6 Nov 2026-6 Jan 2027; daily 10:00-21:00 until 23 Dec (24 Dec until 16:00)

activities.name: SK Rapid Wien v LASK (Bundesliga)
activities.blurb: Saturday-evening league match at Rapid's Allianz Stadion in Hütteldorf, one of Vienna's liveliest football atmospheres.
activities.when: Sat 5 Dec 2026, 19:30 (league fixture list; time may change)

activities.name: Stephansdom
activities.blurb: Gothic cathedral at the heart of the Old Town; the paid tour takes in the cathedral and its treasury.

activities.name: Schönbrunn Palace
activities.blurb: Habsburg summer palace whose state rooms are the main draw; the palace ticket includes an audio guide.
activities.priceText: Palace Ticket with audio guide: adults € 42.00; children from 6 € 30.00

activities.name: Museum Postsparkasse
activities.blurb: Free museum on Otto Wagner's Post Office Savings Bank; the main banking hall is a showpiece Art Nouveau space.

activities.name: Kunsthistorisches Museum
activities.blurb: One of the world's great art museums, with Bruegel and Rubens in a palatial building; open late on Thursdays.
activities.priceText: Adult € 22 online, € 24 at the museum; reduced € 19 online, € 20 on site; under 19 free

activities.name: Schnitzelwirt Schmidt
activities.blurb: Old-school schnitzel house in Neubau with huge portions; the farmer's platter (Bauernschmaus) is the big, filling choice.

activities.name: Naschmarkt
activities.blurb: Vienna's largest market, with produce stalls, food stalls and an oriental-flavoured buzz; good for lunch or a browse.
activities.when: Shops Mon–Sat 06:00–19:30 (Sat to 18:00); food stalls Mon–Sat 06:00–23:00

activities.name: Bermuda Triangle
activities.blurb: Inner-city nightlife area with cheap drinks that draws a young crowd; a lively base for a night out.

activities.name: Loos American Bar
activities.blurb: Tiny Art Deco bar designed by Adolf Loos in 1908, a time-warp interior with late opening hours.

activities.name: Burgtheater behind-the-scenes tour
activities.blurb: Guided behind-the-scenes tour of the 1888 Burgtheater, one of Europe's top German-language theatres; a cheap look inside.
activities.when: Sep–Jun at 15:00 daily; Fri–Sun tours also in English

activities.name: Wiener Eislaufverein ice rink
activities.blurb: Big outdoor ice rink of about 6,000 m² in the Landstraße district, a winter favourite for a relaxed afternoon on the ice.

activities.name: Valencia Marathon (spectate)
activities.blurb: Big-city marathon through Valencia on Sunday 6 Dec; 2026 entries are sold out, but watching along the course is free.
activities.priceText: Free to watch; 2026 race entries are sold out
activities.when: Sun 6 Dec 2026 (start time not published on the site)

activities.name: Christmas lights, tree and ice rink on Plaza del Ayuntamiento
activities.blurb: Giant tree, Saturday 18:30 music-and-fireworks shows and an ice rink in the main square, plus lights across the city.
activities.priceText: Lights and Saturday shows free; ice rink roughly €7-10 per 30-min session (2025-26)
activities.when: 2025-26 pattern: lights 21 Nov-6 Jan, rink 28 Nov-6 Jan (11:00-23:00); 2026 dates TBA

activities.name: Levante UD v Deportivo Alavés (LaLiga)
activities.blurb: Valencia's second club host Alavés on LaLiga matchday 16; Valencia CF are away at Atlético that weekend.
activities.when: LaLiga matchday 16, listed Sun 13 Dec 2026; day/kick-off TBA

activities.name: Valencia Basket v Crvena Zvezda (EuroLeague)
activities.blurb: Valencia Basket host Crvena Zvezda at the Roig Arena in EuroLeague round 16, a Thursday 20:30 tip-off.

activities.name: Catedral de Santa María de València
activities.blurb: Former Roman temple, then a Visigothic church and Moorish mosque; the current Gothic cathedral was begun in 1262.

activities.name: Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciències
activities.blurb: Calatrava's futuristic complex on the old Turia riverbed; the combined ticket is pricey, so pick individual sections.
activities.priceText: Combined admission, mid season: €46.40 adults, €36.30 reduced; valid 3 days (Wikivoyage)

activities.name: Museu de Belles Arts de València
activities.blurb: Free 17th-century palace museum with over 2,000 works, strongest in 14th–17th-century art and medieval altarpieces.

activities.name: Museu de Prehistòria de València
activities.blurb: Free regional prehistory museum covering the Paleolithic to the Visigoths, with the Warrior of Moixent bronze.

activities.name: Kiosco La Pérgola
activities.blurb: Lunch kiosk famous for huge bocadillos, including the Super Bombon with steak, jamón and fries.

activities.name: Mercat Central
activities.blurb: One of Europe's largest markets, in a 1928 modernist iron-and-glass hall; fresh produce, meat, seafood and olives.

activities.name: Café del Duende
activities.blurb: Intimate flamenco café with well-known dancers; the €10 ticket includes a drink, and performances start at 23:00 Thu–Sat.

activities.name: La Fábrica de Hielo
activities.blurb: Former ice factory with nightly concerts by local musicians, plus drinks and tapas; Sundays are devoted to jazz.

activities.name: L'Oceanogràfic
activities.blurb: Europe's largest oceanarium, shaped like a water lily by Félix Candela, with seven ecological zones.

activities.name: Vilnius Christmas Market (Cathedral Square)
activities.blurb: 48 wooden huts on Cathedral Square beside the city's award-winning Christmas tree; a Christmas train circles the Old Town.
activities.when: 28 Nov–27 Dec 2026; tree lighting 28 Nov; Christmas train runs 28 Nov–6 Jan

activities.name: Vilnius Christmas Run
activities.blurb: Annual festive run through Vilnius's decorated streets; check the organisers for registration and route.

activities.name: Paquita ballet at the Lithuanian National Opera and Ballet Theatre
activities.blurb: Classical ballet in the national theatre's main hall; seven performances in the window, about 2 h 10 min with one interval.

activities.name: Vilnius Cathedral
activities.blurb: Cathedral rebuilt after repeated fires since 1251; its baroque St Casimir chapel is the highlight. Free to enter.

activities.name: Gediminas Tower (Upper Castle)
activities.blurb: Tower of the Upper Castle, the hilltop part of a 13th-century castle complex above the Old Town.

activities.name: Gate of Dawn (Aušros vartai)
activities.blurb: Last of Vilnius's medieval city gates still standing, crowned by a chapel with a big icon of the Virgin Mary.

activities.name: Museum of Occupations and Freedom Fights
activities.blurb: Housed in a former KGB headquarters; the focus is the Lithuanian experience of Soviet occupation.

activities.name: Halės turgus (Hale Market Hall)
activities.blurb: The 1906 market hall that resembles a railway station, with food stalls and eateries on its eastern side.

activities.name: Buga Sotu
activities.blurb: Cheap traditional Lithuanian menu (dumplings, kibinai, carp), with live music on Fridays and sometimes Saturdays.

activities.name: BIX
activities.blurb: Rock band's own bar: live rock and metal on Friday nights, karaoke on Thursdays, and a dance floor.

activities.name: Soho Club
activities.blurb: LGBT club that gets very crowded, open on Friday and Saturday nights.

activities.name: Lindy Hop Klubas
activities.blurb: Lindy Hop swing-dance club with lessons and social nights; retro outfits are optional.

activities.name: Akropolis ice rink
activities.blurb: Shopping mall with an ice rink and a multiplex cinema; a simple indoor skate on a cold day.

activities.name: Warsaw Christmas Market (Plac Defilad, Palace of Culture)
activities.blurb: Big Christmas fair under the Palace of Culture and Science with craft stalls, food, a Ferris wheel and carousel (rides extra).
activities.priceText: Free entry (rides such as the Sky 55 wheel cost extra)
activities.when: 20 Nov 2026–6 Jan 2027 per city listing (its text partly recycles 2025/26); 2025 hours Mon–Thu to 21:00, Fri–Sat to 22:00

activities.name: Legia Warszawa vs Pogoń Szczecin (Ekstraklasa)
activities.blurb: League home game for Warsaw's best-known club; the official kick-off time is still to be set.
activities.when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (round 18; kick-off time not yet set)

activities.name: Palace of Culture and Science observation deck
activities.blurb: Warsaw's best-known skyscraper, built in the 1950s as a supposed Stalin 'gift'; its observation deck gives city views.

activities.name: Royal Castle (Zamek Królewski)
activities.blurb: Royal castle in Warsaw's Old Town with several tour routes; the Royal Route is the main draw, open Tuesday to Sunday.
activities.priceText: Royal Route with audio guide 60 zł (reduced 45 zł); special 1 zł without audio guide for EU/EFTA citizens aged 8–26 with birth-date proof
activities.when: Tue–Sun 10:00–17:00 (last entry 16:00); closed Mon, 24, 25 and 31 Dec

activities.name: Królikarnia
activities.blurb: Mokotów palace and park whose name nods to a fake rabbit warren; park and museum are both free.
activities.priceText: Free entrance to the park and the museum

activities.name: Warsaw Rising Museum (Muzeum Powstania Warszawskiego)
activities.blurb: Multimedia museum on the 1944 Warsaw Uprising, a must for most visitors; free admission on Thursdays.
activities.priceText: Regular 35 zł; reduced 30 zł; free admission on Thursdays

activities.name: Prasowy
activities.blurb: Revamped milk bar near Plac Unii: homely, budget cooking given a creative, arts-friendly spin.

activities.name: Zapiecek
activities.blurb: Chain serving pierogi and Polish soups, mostly in the Old and New Town; the menu rarely changes and prices are low.

activities.name: Club 70
activities.blurb: Club spinning 1970s and 1980s hits with a relaxed door and a fun crowd; drinks are on the pricey side.
activities.priceText: Entry free to about 20 zł; 0.5 L beer 10 zł

activities.name: Przekąski Zakąski
activities.blurb: Cult 24/7 bar with 4 zł drinks, currently in a temporary tent in the centre after moving.

activities.name: Alternative Warsaw walking tour
activities.blurb: Two-hour walking tour of Praga covering its history and Warsaw's wider story; pay what you want.

activities.name: Tor Stegny ice rink
activities.blurb: Outdoor ice rink in Warsaw's south that opens only once the temperature drops below 10°C.
activities.when: Open when the temperature is below 10°C

activities.name: Wrocław Christmas Market (Market Square)
activities.blurb: Christmas market spread across the Market Square, Salt Square and nearby streets; craft stalls, food and mulled wine.
activities.when: 20 Nov 2026–7 Jan 2027, daily 10:00–21:00; closed 24–25 Dec and 1 Jan, 26 Dec from 13:00

activities.name: Śląsk Wrocław vs Górnik Zabrze (Ekstraklasa)
activities.blurb: League home game for Śląsk, Wrocław's top football club, against Górnik Zabrze; kick-off time still to be set.
activities.when: Sat 12 Dec 2026 (round 18; kick-off time not yet set)

activities.name: Market Square (Rynek)
activities.blurb: One of Europe's biggest town squares, ringed by photogenic old buildings and the centre of the city's social life.

activities.name: Cathedral Island (Ostrów Tumski)
activities.blurb: Islands on the Oder with brick cathedrals and narrow old streets; a free, atmospheric spot for an evening stroll.

activities.name: Cathedral of St John the Baptist (tower)
activities.blurb: Gothic cathedral with Poland's largest church organ; a lift takes you up the tower for river views over the city.
activities.priceText: Tower 25 zł, reduced 20 zł for under-25s (official site); another official list shows 32 zł / 27 zł

activities.name: Panorama Racławicka
activities.blurb: Giant 1794 battle painting wrapped around a rotunda, showing the Battle of Racławice from every side. Wrocław's most-visited attraction.
activities.priceText: 50 zł adults, 23 zł students & families (per person)
activities.when: Apr–Sep daily 09:00–17:00; Oct–Mar Tue–Sun 09:00–16:00, Mon closed

activities.name: Amalfi
activities.blurb: Thin-crust pizza from a very hot wood oven, run by Italian owners; simple and good value for one person.
activities.priceText: About 15 zł for a pizza for one person

activities.name: Bar Pierożek, ul. Sądowa 7
activities.blurb: Locals rate it Wrocław's best pierogi; try the potato-and-cheese ones with kefir, plus borscht and crêpes.

activities.name: Mleczarnia
activities.blurb: Big pub in a fin-de-siècle building on a quiet street near the courthouse, with dark, cosy wooden interiors over two levels.

activities.name: Setka
activities.blurb: Kitschy, deliberately Communist-style bar open 24/7 with cheap drinks and decent food; a budget late-night stop.
activities.priceText: 4 zł for a glass of beer or a shot of vodka

activities.name: Wrocław Dwarves trail
activities.blurb: Hunt for the small dwarf statues scattered through the city, a playful walk that goes back to the anti-communist Orange Alternative.

activities.name: Zoo Wrocław
activities.blurb: Poland's oldest zoo, opened in 1865 when the city was Prussian Breslau, and the country's largest by number of animals.
activities.priceText: 55 zł adults, 45 zł reduced, 45 zł students

activities.name: Advent in Zagreb (markets, Fuliranje street food, Ice Park)
activities.blurb: Zagreb's big Advent: 'Fuliranje' street food and mulled wine, concerts and the Ice Park on King Tomislav Square.
activities.priceText: Free to wander (food, drink and skating extra)
activities.when: 28 Nov 2026-7 Jan 2027 (official dates); sites include Zrinjevac, Strossmayer promenade and King Tomislav Square

activities.name: La Bohème at HNK Zagreb (opera)
activities.blurb: Puccini's La Bohème at Zagreb's neo-baroque National Theatre; balcony seats from EUR 13 and cheaper for students.
activities.priceText: Category IV (balcony) EUR 13; stalls EUR 27.50-34.90; boxes EUR 44.90; students, pupils and pensioners EUR 9.10 / 19.25 reduced rate (document shown at the box

activities.name: Orašar (The Nutcracker) at HNK Zagreb (ballet)
activities.blurb: Nureyev's Nutcracker, a Christmas-season ballet classic, at the National Theatre; shown 4, 7 and 15 Dec.
activities.priceText: Category IV (balcony) EUR 13; stalls EUR 27.50-34.90; boxes EUR 44.90; students, pupils and pensioners EUR 9.10 / 19.25 reduced rate (document shown at the box
activities.when: Fri 4 Dec, Mon 7 Dec and Tue 15 Dec 2026, 19:30 (more dates 22 Dec-5 Jan)

activities.name: St. Mark's Church
activities.blurb: Church known for its colourful tiled roof with the arms of Croatia and Zagreb; built in 1499 and free to visit.

activities.name: Mirogoj Cemetery
activities.blurb: Zagreb's central cemetery, opened in 1876, with picturesque arcades and a church by H. Bollé; a calm, beautiful walk.

activities.name: Lotrščak Tower
activities.blurb: Upper Town tower with a spiral staircase up to a lookout; the view over the city is the reason to climb.

activities.name: Museum of Broken Relationships
activities.blurb: Museum of objects left behind after break-ups, each with its own story; it has won a Kenneth Hudson award.
activities.priceText: €7, 65+ & students €5.50, children under 12 free with adults

activities.name: Mali Medo (restaurant)
activities.blurb: Traditional Croatian restaurant with a lively, young crowd and affordable mains; the ćevapčići and gulaš are excellent.

activities.name: La Štruk
activities.blurb: One of Zagreb's oldest fast-food spots; try the grilled cheese sandwich or the zagrebački sandwich.

activities.name: Jabuka
activities.blurb: Cult club for alternative and punk music, with cheap weekend drinks and often alternative-band concerts.

activities.name: KSET
activities.blurb: Popular student club with indie and alternative programmes every night; serves only beer and soft drinks.
activities.priceText: Entrance prices from €1.5 (students) to €6-8 for concerts

activities.name: Medvedgrad Castle and Medvednica
activities.blurb: Mountain fortress above Zagreb with wide city views; the site has a memorial, so behave respectfully there.
activities.priceText: Visitor Centre adults €7.95 (weekends), €6.6 (weekdays); many other ticket options

activities.name: Christkindlimarkt at Zürich Main Station
activities.blurb: Covered market in the station hall under a huge tree, with 100+ stalls and light effects overhead; easy to reach on arrival.

activities.name: The Singing Christmas Tree (Werdmühleplatz)
activities.blurb: Christmas market where more than 40 choirs sing on a tree-shaped stage, with daily free concerts and a fondue chalet.
activities.when: 19 Nov-23 Dec 2026; choirs sing daily from 17:30

activities.name: Lichterschwimmen (lantern float on the Limmat)
activities.blurb: Hundreds of tiny school-made lanterns set off down the Limmat at 18:00; hot punch is served for onlookers at Weinplatz.

activities.name: ZSC Lions v SC Bern (National League ice hockey)
activities.blurb: Friday-night ice hockey at the Swiss Life Arena against SC Bern, one of the league's big names; kick-off 19:45.
activities.when: Fri 18 Dec 2026, 19:45 (home games also Sat 5 Dec v SCL Tigers)

activities.name: Grossmünster
activities.blurb: Old Romanesque church where reformer Zwingli was appointed priest in 1519; the steep tower climb gives a great view over Zurich.

activities.name: Zoological Museum of the University of Zurich
activities.blurb: Free university collection: local fauna on the first floor and animals from around the world below; quiet, quirky and budget-friendly.

activities.name: Landesmuseum Zürich (Swiss National Museum)
activities.blurb: Swiss National Museum with history, archaeology and art across the ages; the best single overview of how Switzerland got here.
activities.priceText: Adults CHF 13; concessions CHF 10 (incl. students); children up to 16 free

activities.name: Kunsthaus Zürich
activities.blurb: Zurich's main art museum, strong on Swiss painters such as Hodler and sculptor Giacometti, plus major international works.
activities.priceText: Fr. 16/11 for the permanent collection; free on Wednesdays

activities.name: Zeughauskeller
activities.blurb: Historic 1487 guild hall serving hearty sausages, stews and rösti in a Brauhaus setting; touristy, but the portions are big and good.

activities.name: Globus Bellevue food hall
activities.blurb: Food-focused Globus store near Stadelhofen with a large ground-floor eatery serving fusion dishes; handy for a quick bite.

activities.name: Helsinki
activities.blurb: Small bar-club with live concerts most nights and an outdoor area in summer; a home for independent acts from across Switzerland.

activities.name: Gonzo
activities.blurb: Basement club, mostly not electronic; long queues and a strict door, but Wednesday hip-hop and Thursday student nights are fun.

activities.name: Uetliberg
activities.blurb: Hill above Zurich with a 360-degree tower view; hike up, or take the S10 from the main station in about 20 minutes.
activities.priceText: Tower CHF 2.50; train covered by a ZVV ticket or Zürich Card

activities.name: Zoo Zürich
activities.blurb: Zoo with the big Masoala Rainforest Hall, an indoor tropical environment that suits a cold December day.
